शवंरोचना: शवंरोचना f. (-ना) An earthy concretion of a milk-white colour, formed in the hollow of the bamboo, an known by the name of bamboo-manna.  E. वंश the bamboo, रुच् to shine, aff. युच्; also र being changed to ल, वंशलोचना ।
श: श The thirtieth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and first of the three sibilants; it is termed the palatal sibilant, and corresponds to “Sh” pronounced softly, as in Shun; in the Roman character it is distinguished by an accent, as Ś.
श m. (-शः) 	 1. A name of ŚIVA. 	 2. A weapon. 	 3. A cutter, a destroyer. n. Adv. (-शं) or Ind. (शं or शम्) Happy, happily, auspiciously. E. शी to sleep or शी to pare, &c., aff. ड ।
शंयु: शंयु mfn. (-युः-युः-युं) Happy, prosperous, fortunate. 	 m. (-युः) A sort of snake.  E. शम् happily, and युस् aff.
शंय्य: शंय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Happy, fortunate. 	 f. (-य्या) Knowledge, under-standing.  E. शम् happily, and यस् aff.
शंव: शंव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Fortunate, prosperous. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. The thunder-bolt of INDRA. 	 2. The iron head of a pestle.  E. श good fortune, and व poss. aff.; also as differently derived, read शम्ब and सम्ब &c.
शंवर: शंवर n. (-रं) Water.  E. शं happily, वृ to choose or cover, aff. अच् or अरप्; more usually read शम्बर. q. v.
शंस्: शंस्(उ)शंसु r. 1st cl. (शसति) 	 1. To praise. 	 2. To hurt. 	 3. To wish. 	 4. To calumniate. 	 5. To suggest. 	 6. To report, to relate, (with a dat. or gen. of the person communicated to.) With अभि prefixed, To accuse wrongfully. With आङ्, 1. To hope. 	 2. To speak. 	 3. To wish. With प्र, To praise, to flatter; this root and its derivatives are sometimes read with the palatal sibilant final or शंश, &c.
शंसन: शंसन n. (-नं) 	 1. The act of reciting. 	 2. Praising.
शंसा: शंसा f. (-सा) 	 1. Narrating. 	 2. Wish, desire. 	 3. Praise, flattery, eulo-gium.  E. शंस् to praise, &c., affs. अङ् and टाप्.
शंसित: शंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Established, ascertained. 	 2. Calumniated, falsely accused. 	 3. Said, declared. 	 4. Praised, celebrated. 	 5. Wished, desired.  E. शंस् to wish, aff. क्त ।
शंसिन्: शंसिन् f. (-नी) 	 1. Saying, indicating. 	 2. Praising, (used at the end of a compound.)
शंस्तृ: शंस्तृ m. (-स्ता) An encomiast, a panegyrist, a flatterer.  E. शंस् to praise, तृन् Unādi aff.
शंस्थ: शंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Happy, prosperous, well-faring.  E. शं happily, स्था to stay or be, aff. क ।
शंस्य: शंस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 	 1. Desirable, to be wished. 	 2. Meritorious, to be praised.  E. शस् to praise, &c., aff. ण्यत् or क्यप्; also शस्य ।
शक्: शक् r. 4th cl. (शक्यति-ते) (इर ऌ) इरशकॢ r. 5th cl. (शक्नोति) 	 1. To bear patiently, to endure, to be patient. 	 2. To be able to effect, to be competent. 	 3. To be powerful, (generally with an inf.) (इ) शकि r. 1st cl. (शङ्कते) 	 1. To think probable, to suspect. 	 2. To fear, to apprehend. With आङ्, To dread.
शक: शक m. (-कः) 	 1. A sovereign, and prince who gives his name to an era, especially applied to SĀLIVĀHANA. 	 2. A particular caste, the followers or descendants of ŚAKA or SĀLIVĀHANA. 	 3. A country. m. plu. (-काः) 	 1. The inhabitants, the Sacæ, the Scythians. 	 2. An era: see शाक.  E. शक् to be able, aff. अच् ।
शकट: शकट mfn. Subst. (-टः-टी-टं) A cart. 	 m. (-टः) 	 1. A Daitya slain by KRISHṆA. 	 2. A cart-load. 	 3. A form of military array resembling a wedge. 	 4. A measure of capacity equal to two thousand Panas. E. शक् to be able, अटन् Unādi aff.
शकटहन्: शकटहन् m. (-हा) KRISHṆA.  E. शकट the demon so named, and हन् des-troyer; also similar compounds, as शकटारि &c.
शकटाल: शकटाल m. (-लः) The minister of NANDA: also read SAKATĀRA.
शकटाह्वा: शकटाह्वा f. (-ह्वा) The fourth lunar asterism, called Rohinī, the stars of which are represented as a cart.  E. शकट a cart, आह्व appellation.
शकटिका: शकटिका f. (-का) A small cart, a toy-cart.  E. कन् added to शकटी ।
शकन्: शकन् n. (-का) Animal-dung; this word has no forms for the first five cases; according to some this is not a separate word but a substi-tute for शकृत् ।
शकल: शकल mn. (-लः-लं) A part, a portion, a piece. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Skin. 	 2. Bark. 3. A kind of (black) pigment or die. 	 4. The scales of a fish.  E. शक् to be able, कलच् Unādi aff.
शकलिन्: शकलिन् m. (-ली) A fish.  E. शकल skin or scales, and इनि aff.
शकलीकरण: शकलीकरण n. (-णं) Parting, dividing, cutting or breaking in pieces. E. शकल, करण making, with च्वि aug.
शकलीकृत: शकलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Parted, cut in pieces, wounded,  E. शकल, कृत made, च्वि aug.
शकशकायत्: शकशकायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Rustling, making a noise, (as the leaves of a tree in the wind.)  E. शकत् imitative sound, nominal v., शतृ aff.
शकान्तक: शकान्तक m. (-कः) 	 1. The prince VIKPAMĀDITYA. 	 2. The name of SĀLI-VĀHANA.  E. शक an era or a Scythian, अन्तक destroyer.
शकाब्द: शकाब्द n. (-ब्दं) 	 1. A year of the Saka era, or era of SĀLIVĀHANA. E. शक, अब्द a year.
शकार: शकार m. (-रः) 	 1. A silly brother-in-law of a Rājā. 	 2. The brother of a king's concubine.
शकरि: शकरि m. (-रिः) VIKRAMĀDITYA, the celebrated sovereign of Oujein. E. शक a Saca or Scythian, अरि the foe.
शकुन: शकुन m. (-नः) 	 1. A bird in general. 	 2. A kind of bird, either the Indian vulture or the common kite, (Falco cheela;) it is also applied to the pondicherry eagle, (Falco ponticeriana.) 	 3. A sort of hymn or song, sung at festivals to solicit or secure lucky events. 	 n. (-न) Any lucky or inauspicious object or omen.  E. शक् to be able, उनन् Unādi aff.
शकुनज्ञा: शकुनज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) A small house-lizard.  E. शकुन a bird, and ज्ञ who knows.
शकुनि: शकुनि m. (-निः) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. The maternal uncle of the Kaurava princes, and counsellor or DURYODHANA. 	 3. One of the astrono-mical periods called Karaṇas. 	 4. The Indian kite or eagle, (Falco cheela.) 	 f. (-नी) A hen-sparrow.  E. शक् to be able, उनि Unādi aff.
शकुनिप्रपा: शकुनिप्रपा f. (-पा) A trough or little well for watering birds.  E. शकुनि a bird, प्र before पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
शकुनिवाद: शकुनिवाद m. (-दः) 	 1. The sound of a bird. 	 2. The crowing of a cock.
शकुनीश्वर: शकुनीश्वर m. (-रः) A name of GARUDA.  E. शकुनि a bird, and ईश्वर chief.
शकुन्त: शकुन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. A bird. 	 2. A kind of bird, the Indian vulture. 	 3. Another sort of bird, described as of aquatic habits, perhaps a kind of maritime or fishing-falcon. 	 4. A sort of insect. 	 5. The blue-jay. E. शक् to be able, उन्त Unādi aff.; also शकुन, &c.
शकुन्तक: शकुन्तक m. (-कः) A bird. 	 f. (-न्तिका) 	 1. A kind of bird. 	 2. A locust. E. कन् added to the last.
शकुन्तला: शकुन्तला f. (-ला) The daughter of MENAKĀ, the courtezan of Swarga, by the sage VISHWĀMITRA, brought up by KANWA the hermit, and afterwards married to DUSHYANTA, by whom she became the mother of BHARATA, the sovereign of all India.  E. शकुन्त a bird, ला to get, affs. क and टाप्, being born in a solitary forest, and protected by the birds till found by KANWA.
शकुन्तलात्मज: शकुन्तलात्मज m. (-जः) BHARATA, the sovereign of India.  E. शकुन्तला as above, आत्मज the son.
शकुन्ति: शकुन्ति m. (-न्तिः) 	 1. A bird in general. 	 2. A kind of bird: see शकुन्त, &c. E. शक् to be able, Unādi aff. उन्ति ।
शकुन्तिका: शकुन्तिका f. (-का) A locust, a cricket.  E. शकुन्त a bird, कन् aff. of comparison.
शकुल: शकुल mf. (-लः-ली) A kind of fish. “शील”.  E. शक् to be able, aff. उलच् ।
शकुलगण्ड: शकुलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of fish. “शालमाछ ।”
शकुलाक्षक: शकुलाक्षक m. (-कः) Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon,) with white bloss-oms.  E. शकुल a kind of fish, अक्षि the eye, अच् substituted for the final vowel; the blossoms being compared to the eye of a fish.
शकुलादनी: शकुलादनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A medicinal plant, commonly Kaṭuki, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 	 2. A creeping plant, (Jussieua repens.) 	 3. A drug, commonly Kāyaphal. 	 4. An earth-worm.  E. शकुल a fish, अद् to eat, aff. ल्युट् ।
शकुलार्भक: शकुलार्भक m. (-कः) A sort of fish. “गडुइ माछ ।”  E. शकुल a fish, अर्भक a young one.
शकृत्: शकृत् n. (-कृत्) Fæces, excrement.  E. शक् to be able, (to expel,) Unādi aff. ऋतन् ।
शकृत्करि: शकृत्करि mf. (-रिः-री) A calf.  E. शकृत् ordure. कृ to make, इन् aff.
शकृत्कार: शकृत्कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making ordure or fæces.  E. शकृत् ordure, and कार who or what makes.
शकृद्द्वार: शकृद्द्वार n. (-रं) The anus.  E. शकृत् fæces, and द्वार passage.
शक्कर: शक्कर m. (-रः) A bull. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A river. 	 2. A zone, a girdle. 	 3. A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of fourteen syllables each. 	 4. A woman of an impure caste; it is also read शक्वर, q. v.
शक्करि: शक्करि m. (-रिः) A bull: see the last.
शक्त: शक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Able, capable, strong, powerful. 	 2. Speaking civilly, able to please by the manner of speaking. 	 3. Diligent, attentive, intent. 	 4. Opulent, rich. 	 5. Significant, expressive, (as a word.)  E. शक् to be able, aff. क्त ।
शक्तता: शक्तता f. (-ता) Ability, power.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व शक्तत्वं ।
शक्ति: शक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. Power, regal power as resulting from “प्रभुशक्ति” or “प्रभाव-शक्ति” majesty, “उत्साहशक्ति” energy, perseverance, “मन्त्रशक्ति” the power of god counsel: see शक्तित्रय. 	 2. Power, strength, prowess. 	 3. An iron spear or dart. 	 4. The energy or active power of a deity, per-sonified as his wife, as GAURĪ of ŚIVA, LAKSHMĪ of VISHṆU, &c. 5. The female organ as the counterpart of the phallic personifica-tion of ŚIVA, and worshipped either literally or figuratively by a sect of Hindus, thence termed ŚĀKTAS. 	 6. Allaying or appeasing opposition. 	 7. Force or signification of words, (op. to लक्षणा and व्यञ्जना.) 	 8. The relation of a word to the thing designated by it, (in Nyāya Phil.) 	 9. Poetic genius. 	 10. The inherent power of a cause to produce its effects, (in Nyāya Phil.)  E. शक् to be able, aff. क्तिन् ।
शक्तिग्रह: शक्तिग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. A name of ŚIVA. 	 2. KĀRTIKEYA. 	 3. A spearman, a lancer. 	 4. Apprehending the meaning or acceptation of a word. E. शक्ति a spear, and ग्रह who holds.
शक्तितस्: शक्तितस् Ind. According to power or ability.  E. शक्ति and तसि aff.
शक्तित्रय: शक्तित्रय n. (-यं) The three ingredients of regal power; or king, minister, and vigour.  E. शक्ति, and त्रय triad: see शक्ति ।
शक्तिधर: शक्तिधर m. (-रः) 	 1. A name of KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. A spearman, a lancer. Adj. Developed, powerful  E. शक्ति a spear, धर the holder.
शक्तिपर्ण: शक्तिपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A tree, (Echites scholaris)  E. शक्ति strength, (giving it,) पर्ण a leaf.
शक्तिपाणि: शक्तिपाणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. A spearman.  E. शक्ति a spear, पाणि the hand.
शक्तिभृत्: शक्तिभृत् m. (-भृत्) 	 1. KĀRTIKEYA: see the last. 	 2. A soldier armed with a spear.  E. शक्ति a spear, and भृत् who holds.
शक्तिमत्: शक्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Powerful, mighty.  E. शक्ति, मतुप् poss. aff.
शक्तिवैकल्य: शक्तिवैकल्य n. (-ल्यं) Inability, deficiency of power or strength.  E. शक्ति, वैकल्य imperfection.
शक्तिहीन: शक्तिहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Powerless, impotent.  E. शक्ति, हीन abandoned.
शक्तिहेतिक: शक्तिहेतिक m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer, a soldier armed with an iron lance.  E. शक्ति a spear, हेति a weapon, and कप् added.
शक्तु: शक्तु mn. (-क्तुः-क्तु) According to some authorities only. 	 m. plu. (शक्तवः) The powder or flour of barley and other grain, first fried and then ground.  E. शच् to go, &c., तुन् aff.; also read सक्तु ।
शक्तुफला: शक्तुफला f. (-ला) The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.)  E. शक्त farina, and फल fruit; also शक्तुफली, and सक्तुफला ।
शक्त्यपेक्ष: शक्त्यपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Being according to, or having reference to, ability, power, &c.  E. शक्ति and अपेक्षा regard to.
शक्न: शक्न mfn. (-क्नः-क्ना-क्नं) Speaking civilly or pleasingly: see the next.
शक्नु: शक्नु mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु) Speaking civilly or kindly.  E. शक् to be able, (to please by speaking,) aff. नु; also with क्ल aff. शक्ल ।
शक्मन्: शक्मन् m. (-क्मा) Power, strength.  E. शक् to be able, मनिन् Unādi aff.
शक्य: शक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) 	 1. Possible, practicable to be effected or done, (generally with an inf.) 	 2. Fit to be effected or accomplished. 	 3. Directly expressed, (as the meaning of a word.)  E. शक् to be able, aff. यत् ।
शक्यता: शक्यता f. (-ता) Possibility.  E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शक्यत्वं ।
शक्यप्रतीकार: शक्यप्रतीकार m. (-रः) A possible remedy or counteragent.
शक्र: शक्र m. (-क्रः) 	 1. INDRA, the chief of the inferior gods, and ruler of Swarga or paradise. 	 2. A plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 	 3. A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 	 4. An owl. 	 5. The number “fourteen” E. शक् to possess power, Unādi aff. रक् ।
शक्रक्रीडाचल: शक्रक्रीडाचल m. (-लः) Mount Meru.  E. शक INDRA, क्रीडा sport, pleasure, अचल a mountain.
शक्रगोप: शक्रगोप m. (-पः) An insect of a red colour, “इन्द्रगोप”, (Coccinella or ladybird of various species.)  E. शक्र INDRA, गो light, &c., पा to preserve, aff. क; or शक्रं शक्रधनुर्गापायति समवर्णत्वात् गुप-अण् ।
शक्रज: शक्रज m. (-जः) A crow  E. शक्र INDRA, and ज born.
शक्रजात: शक्रजात m. (-तः) A crow.  E. शक्र INDRA, and जात born.
शक्रजित्: शक्रजित् m. (-जित्) MEGHANĀDA, the son of RĀVAṆA.  E. शक्र INDRA, जित् victor.
शक्रधनुस्: शक्रधनुस् n. (-नुः) The bow of INDRA, the rain bow.  E. शक्र INDRA, and धनुस् the bow.
शक्रध्वज: शक्रध्वज n. (-जं) A pole or flag set up in honour of INDRA.  E. शक्र and ध्वज a flag.
शक्रनन्दन: शक्रनन्दन m. (-नः) ARJUNA.  E. शक्र INDRA, नन्दन a son.
शक्रपादप: शक्रपादप m. (-पः) 	 1. A sort of pine, (P. devadaru, Rox.) 	 2. The Kutaja-tree.  E. शक्र INDRA, पादप a tree.
शक्रपुष्पी: शक्रपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A sort of potherb; also Viśalyā.  E. शक्र the pentaptera arjuna, and पुष्प a flower; having similar flowers.
शक्रभवन: शक्रभवन n. (-नं) Sky, heaven.  E. शक्र INDRA, भवन abode; being the god of the firmament: it also occurs शक्रभुवन, from भुवन a world.
शक्रभिद्: शक्रभिद् m. (-भिद्) The son of RĀVAṆA.  E. शक्र INDRA, भिद् defeater.
शक्रमूर्द्धन्: शक्रमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) An ant-hill, a hillock.  E. शक्र INDRA, मूर्द्धन् the head.
शक्रवाहन: शक्रवाहन m. (-नः) A cloud.  E. शक्र INDRA and वाहन a vehicle.
शक्रशरासन: शक्रशरासन n. (-नं) The rain-bow.  E. शक्र INDRA, शरासन a bow.
शक्रशाला: शक्रशाला f. (-ला) A place prepared for sacrifices to be offered in.  E. शक्र INDRA, and शाला a hall.
शक्रशिरस्: शक्रशिरस् n. (-रः) An ant-hill.  E. शक्र, शिरस the head.
शक्रसारथि: शक्रसारथि m. (-थिः) MĀTULI, the charioteer of INDRA.  E. शक्र, सारथि a coachman.
शक्रसुत: शक्रसुत m. (-तः) 	 1. The monkey king BĀLĪ. 	 2. ARJUNA. 	 3. JAYANTA. E. शक्र INDRA, सुत son.
शक्रसुधा: शक्रसुधा f. (-धा) The resin of the Boswellia thurifera, or gum olibanum.  E. शक्र, सुधा ambrosia.
शक्रसृष्टा: शक्रसृष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)  E. शक्र INDRA, सृष्ट created; springing originally, it is said, from the ground on which INDRA spilt a drop of nectar as he was drinking.
शक्राख्य: शक्राख्य m. (-ख्यः) An owl.  E. “शक्रस्येवाख्या यस्य ।”
शक्राणी: शक्राणी f. (-णी) ŚACHĪ, the wife of INDRA.  E. शक्र INDRA, ङीष् aff. आनुक् inserted.
शक्राशन: शक्राशन m. (-नः) A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)  E. शक्र INDRA, अशन food: created by him; springing from the drops of Amrita which fell on the ground from the bodies of the monkies slain in the war with RĀVAṆA, and who were restored to life by INDRA by a shower of Amrita, or the liquor of immortality.
शक्रि: शक्रि m. (-क्रिः) 	 1. A cloud. 	 2. Thunder-bolt. 	 3. An elephant.  E. शक्-क्रिन् ।

शब्दशास्त्र: शब्दशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Philology, grammar, &c.  E. शब्द, शास्त्र a science, &c.
शब्दश्लेष: शब्दश्लेष m. (-षः) A play upon words, a verbal equivoque, a pun, (it differs from अर्थश्लेष in that the figure vanishes if the words on which it depends are substituted by others of the same meaning.)
शब्दसंग्रह: शब्दसंग्रह m. (-हः) A vocabulary, a lexicon.  E. शब्द, and संग्रह collection.
शब्दादि: शब्दादि m. (-दिः) The objects of sense, viz:--sound, form, scent, juice, contact; or what affords matter for the exercise of hearing, seeing, smelling, tasting and touching.  E. शब्द, and आदि other.
शब्दाधिष्ठान: शब्दाधिष्ठान n. (-नं) The ear.  E. शब्द sound, अधिष्ठान receptacle.
शब्दानुरूप: शब्दानुरूप n. (-पं) 	 1. Conformity or proportion to the sound. 	 2. Imita-tion of sound.  E. शब्द, अनुरूप conformity.
शब्दानुशासन: शब्दानुशासन n. (-नं) The acceptation or sense of words.  E. शब्द, अनुशासन government.
शब्दायमान: शब्दायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding.  E. शब्द sound, nominal verb, शानच् aff.
शब्दार्थ: शब्दार्थ m. (-र्थः) 	 1. The sense or meaning of words. 	 2. Words and sense. E. शब्द, अर्थ sense.
शब्दालङ्कार: शब्दालङ्कार m. (-रः) Rhetorical use of words; verbal figure, as alliter-ation, &c.  E. शब्द and अलङ्कार ornament.
शब्दित: शब्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sounded. 	 2. Uttered, articulated. 	 3. Explained, made public or manifest. 	 4. Converted into a noun, &c.  E. शब्द् to sound. क्त aff.; or शब्द, and इतच् aff.
शम्: शम्(इर् उ)इरश्मु r. 4th cl. (शाम्यति) 	 1. To be pacified, to be calmed or appeased. 	 2. To pacify, to calm. 	 3. To be tranquil, to have the passions tamed and quiescent. r. 10th cl. (शामयते) To look, to look at or inspect. (शमयति-ते) To allay, to appease. (शामयति) To display. With उप prefixed, To tranquillize, to ally, to tame. With नि, 1. To hear. 	 2. To observe, to perceive. 	 3. To restrain or prevent. With प्र, 1. To destroy. 	 2. To be very tranquil. 	 3. To be soothed. 	 4. To cease. 	 5. To fade away. With सम्, To be extinguished.
शम् Ind. A particle meaning “welfare, prosperity, blessing, health,” (with a dat. or gen.)
शम: शम m. (-मः) 	 1. Quiet of mind, stoicism, indifference, the absence of passion, as one of the qualities of the Vedāntī or follower of the Vedānta doctrine; it is defined to be the exclusion of every idea not derived from the precepts of that philosophy, and is so far synonymous with abstract meditation on BRAHMĀ, or God. 	 2. Quiet, tranquillity, rest, calm, (in general.) 	 3. Final happiness, emancipation from human existence. 	 4. Cure, convalescence, alleviation of pain or disease. 	 5. Abuse, imprecation, malediction. 6. The hand.  E. शम् to be pacified or calm, aff. घञ्, and the vowel not made long.
शमक: शमक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Pacifier, pacificator, tranquillizing.  E. शम् to be tranquil, ण्वुल् aff. of attributive agency.
शमथ: शमथ m. (-थः) 	 1. Quiet, tranquillity: (see the last) 	 2. A counsellor, a minister.  E. शम् to be calm, Unādi aff. अथच् ।
शमन: शमन n. (-नं) 	 1. Killing animals for sacrifice, immolation. 	 2. Mental tranquillity, calmness, indifference. 	 3. Abuse, malediction. 	 4. Hurt, injury. 	 5. Chewing, swallowing. 	 6. The act of appeasing, soothing, consoling. 	 7. Cessation, end, destruction. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. YAMA, the ruler of Tartarus. 	 2. An antelope. 	 f. (-नी) Night. E. शम् to be tranquil, aff. ल्युट् or युच् ।
शमनस्वसृ: शमनस्वसृ f. (-सा) YAMUNĀ, the personified river.  E. शमन YAMA and स्वसृ the sister.
शमनीषद: शमनीषद m. (-दः) A Rākshasa, an evil spirit, a goblin.  E. शमन night, षद who goes.
शमयत्: शमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 	 1. Appeasing, allaying. 	 2. Terminating, stopping.  E. शम् to pacify, शतृ aff.
शमल: शमल n. (-लं) 	 1. Fæces, ordure. 	 2. Sin, impurity.  E. शम् to be quiet, Unādi aff. कलच् ।
शमान्तक: शमान्तक m. (-कः) The deity KĀMA or love, (personified.)  E. शम mental or devotional tranquillity, अन्तक destroyer.
शमि: शमि f. (-मिः or मी) A legume or pod. 	 f. (-मी) 	 1. The Sami tree, (Acacia suma, Rox.) 	 2. A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica.)  E. शम् to pacify, (sickness,) aff. इन्, ङीष् added.
शमित: शमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Pacified, appeased. 	 2. Quiet, tranquil, calm. 3. Alleviated, relieved. 	 4. Tempered, moderated. 	 5. Relaxed, intermitted.  E. शम् to be pacified or calm, aff. क्त ।
शमिन्: शमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Pacific, tranquillized.  E. शम् to be tranquil, aff. णिनि ।
शमिर: शमिर m. (-रः) A variety of the Śami tree.  E. शमी the Śami tree, रा to get, (to resemble,) aff. क, and the vowel made short; also शमीर ।
शमिरोह: शमिरोह m. (-हः) ŚIVA.  E. शमि for शमी the Śami tree, रोह who ascends.
शमीगर्भ: शमीगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 	 1. A man of the sacerdotal class, a Brāhman. 	 2. A name of AGNI or fire.  E. शमी the mimosa, (the wood of which is essential for certain sacrifice, &c.) and गर्भ embryo.
शमीधान्य: शमीधान्य n. (-न्यं) Pulse, grain which grows in legumes or pods.  E. शमी a legume, and धान्य grain.
शमीपत्री: शमीपत्री f. (-त्री) A sort of sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.)  E. शमी Acacia Suma, and पत्र the leaf; having a similar leaf.
शमीर: शमीर m. (-रः) A small variety of the Mimosa Suma.  E. शमी the Śami tree, and र aff. of diminution; also sometimes read शमिर ।
शम्पा: शम्पा f. (-म्पा) Lightning.  E. शम् happiness, पा to drink, क and टाप् affs.; destroying pleasure by its awful appearance.
शम्पाक: शम्पाक m. (-कः) 	 1. A kind of Cassia, (C. fistula.) 	 2. Bringing to matu-rity or ripeness, cooking, maturing. 	 3. The lac pigment.  E. शम् pleasure and पाक what matures; also सम्पाक ।
शम्ब्: शम्ब् r. 1st cl. (शम्बति) To go. r. 10th cl. (शम्बयति-ते) To accumulate, to collect or heap together.
शम्ब: शम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) 	 1. Happy, fortunate. 	 2. Poor, indigent. 	 m. (-म्बः) 1. INDRA'S thunderbolt. 	 2. The iron head of a pestle. 	 3. An iron chain worn round the loins. 	 4. The second ploughing of a field. E. शम् happiness, and ब possessive aff.; or शम्ब् to accumulate, aff. अच्; it is also read सव, शंव, and सम्ब ।
शम्बर: शम्बर n. (-रं) 	 1. Water. 	 2. A religious observance. 	 3. Wealth. 	 m. (-रः) 1. A Daitya. 	 2. A sort of deer. 	 3. A mountain. 	 4. A fish in gener-al. 	 5. War. 	 6. Best, excellent. 	 7. A Bauddha. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. A drug or medicinal plant, (Anthericum tuberosum.) 	 2. A female juggler. E. शम्ब् to accumulate, अरन् aff.; or श happiness, वृ to choose, aff. अप्; also read शंवर and सम्बर or संवर ।
शम्बरसूदन: शम्बरसूदन m. (-नः) A name of PRADYUMNA.  E. शम्बर the Daitya, सूदन destroyer.
शम्बरारि: शम्बरारि m. (-रिः) PRADYUMNA.  E. शम्बर the Daitya, अरि the foe.
शम्बल: शम्बल mn. (-लः-लं) 	 1. Provender for a journey, stock for travelling expences. 	 2. A bank, a shore. 	 3. Envy, impatience or dislike of another's success. 	 f. (-ली) A procuress, a bawd.  E. शम्ब् to go, to collect, कलच् aff.; also शवल, and सम्बल or संवल ।
शम्बाकृत: शम्बाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice-ploughed, (a field.)  E. शम्ब a second ploughing, कृत made, and डाच् augment.
शम्बु: शम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A bivalve-shell. E. See शम्बूक below.
शम्बुक: शम्बुक m. (-कः) A bivalve-shell: see शम्बूक ।
शम्बुक्क: शम्बुक्क m. (-क्कः) A bivalve-shell: see the next.
शम्बूक: शम्बूक mf. (-कः-का) A bivalve-shell. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A conch-shell. 	 2. A snail. 	 3. A Sūdra, who had become a devotee in the time of RĀMACHANDRA, and was slain by him. 	 4. The edge of the frontal protuberance of the elephant. 	 5. The name of a Daitya.  E. शम् to be tranquil, ऊकन् aff. and वुक् augment; also with the vowel short, शम्बुक, and the final consonant then rejected, शम्बु; it is also read, शम्बुक्क and with the first vowel long, शाम्बूक, &c.
शम्भ: शम्भ m. (-म्भः) 	 1. INDRA'S thunder-bolt. 	 2. The iron bound head of a club or pestle. 	 3. A happy man.  E. शम् particle of auspiciousness, भा to shine, aff. क ।
शम्भली: शम्भली f. (-ली) A bawd, a procuress.  E. शम् pleasure, भल् to describe, अच् and ङीष् affs.
शम्भु: शम्भु m. (-म्भुः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. BRAHMĀ. 	 3. A Jaina sanctified teacher. 4. A Siddha, a demi-divine being. 	 5. A sage, a venerable man. 	 6. A kind of Asclepias.  E. शम् auspicious particle, भू to be, डु aff.
शम्भुतनय: शम्भुतनय m. (-यः) 	 1. KĀRTTIKEYA. 	 2. GAṆEŚA.  E. शम्भु ŚIVA, तनय son.
शम्भुनन्दन: शम्भुनन्दन m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of GAṆEŚA. 	 2. A name of KARTIKEYA. E. शम्भु ŚIVA, नन्दन son.
शम्भुप्रिया: शम्भुप्रिया f. (-या) 	 1. Emblic myrobalan. 	 2. An epithet of DURGĀ. E. शम्भु ŚIVA, प्रिया beloved.
शम्या: शम्या f. (-म्या) 	 1. The pin of a yoke. 	 2. A sacrificial vessel. 	 3. A stick, a staff.  E. शम् to be kept quiet, यत् aff., fem. aff. टाप् ।
शम्यापात: शम्यापात m. (-तः) The cast of a stick.  E. शम्या and पात alighting.
शय: शय mfn. (-यः-या or यी-यं) Asleep, sleeping. 	 m. (-यः) 	 1. A hand. 	 2. A snake, (Boa constrictor.) 	 3. Sleep, sleeping. 	 4. A bed, a couch. 	 5. Abuse, imprecation.  E. शी to sleep, aff. घ, टच् or अच् ।
शयण्ड: शयण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं) Asleep, sleeping,  E. शी to sleep, अण्डच् Unādi aff.
शयथ: शयथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Asleep, sleeping. 	 m. (-थः) 	 1. Death, dying. 	 2. A sort of snake, the Boa. 	 3. A boar. 	 4. A fish.  E. शी to sleep, अथच् Unādi aff.
शयन: शयन n. (-नं) 	 1. Sleep. 	 2. A bed, a couch. 	 3. Copulation.  E. शी to sleep, ल्युट् aff.
शयनगृह: शयनगृह n. (-हं) A bed-chamber.  E. शयन and गृह house.
शयनागार: शयनागार m. (-रः) A bed chamber.  E. शयन and आगार house.
शयनीय: शयनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit for or suitable to sleep, to be slept on, &c. n. (-यं) A bed, a couch.  E. शी to sleep, अनीयर् aff. of the future participle; also with कन् added शयनीयक n. (-कं) ।
शयनैकादशी: शयनैकादशी f. (-शी) The eleventh day of the light-half of Āshādha, on which VISHNU'S sleep commences.  E. शयन, एकादशी 11th lunation.
शयान: शयान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sleeping, asleep.  E. शी to sleep, शानच् aff.
शयानक: शयानक m. (-कः) 	 1. A snake. 	 2. A lizard.  E. शी to sleep, आनक् Unādi aff.
शयालु: शयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Sleepy, slothful, sluggish. 	 m. (-लुः) 	 1. A kind of snake, the Boa. 	 2. A dog. 	 3. A jackal.  E. शी to sleep, आलुच् aff, implying disposition or habit.
शयित: शयित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asleep. 	 n. (-तं) A plant, (Cordia myxa.) 	 n. (-तं) Sleep, sleeping.  E. शी to sleep, aff. क्त ।
शयितवत्: शयितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sleeping, asleep.  E. शीङ् to sleep, क्तवतु aff.
शयित्वा: शयित्वा Ind. Having slept.  E. शी to sleep, क्त्वा aff.
शयु: शयु m. (-युः) A large snake, (Boa.)  E. शी to sleep, उ Unādi aff.
शयुन: शयुन m. (-नः) A large kind of snake, (Boa.)  E. शीङ् to sleep, Unādi aff. उनन् ।
शय्या: शय्या f. (-य्या) 	 1. A bed, a couch, a sopha. 	 2. Tying in knots, stringing. E. शी to sleep, क्यप् aff., and अयङ् substituted for the vowel.
शर: शर m. (-रः) 	 1. A sort of reed or grass, (Saccharum sara.) 	 2. An arrow. 3. The upper part or cream of slightly curdled milk. 	 4. Mischief, injury, hurt. 	 5. The number “five.” n. (-रं) 	 1. Water. 	 2. Versed sine of an arc.  E. शॄ to hurt, aff. अप् or अच्; also सर ।
शरकाण्ड: शरकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. The stem of the Saccharum. 	 2. The shaft of an arrow.  E. शर, काण्ड stem.
शरच्चन्द्र: शरच्चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The autumnal moon.  E. शरद्, चन्द्र moon.
शरज: शरज n. (-जं) Butter made from milk one day old.  E. शर cream, ज born.
शरजन्मन्: शरजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A name of KĀRTIKEYA.  E. शर a sort of grass, and जन्मन् birth: having been brought up in thickets of that grass.
शरट: शरट m. (-टः) 	 1. A lizard, a chamæleon. 	 2. Safflower, the plant.  E. शॄ to hurt, अटन् aff.; also सरट ।
शरण: शरण n. (-णं) 	 1. A house. 	 2. A preserver, a protector, what or who protects or preserves. 	 3. Preservation, protection, defence. 	 4. Killing, slaying. 	 f. (-णी) A plant, (Celtis.)  E. श to injure, aff. ल्युट्.
शरणागत: शरणागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Refuge, appellant, one who comes for protec-tion or refuge.  E. शरण protection, and आगत come.
शरणापन्न: शरणापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Taken refuge.  E. शरण and आपन्न obtained.
शरणार्थिन्: शरणार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Unfortunate, wretched, involved in cala-mity or ruin, and dependent on others for protection or aid. E. शरण protection, and अर्थिन् soliciting, requiring.
शरणार्पक: शरणार्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, calamitous, distressed, ruined: (see the last.)  E. शरण protection, अर्पक who causes to be afforded.
शरणि: शरणि mf. (-णिः-णी) A road, a path, a way.  E. शॄ to hurt, अनि aff.; more usually सरणि ।
शरणैषिन्: शरणैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking for an asylum or protection.  E. शरण, एषिन् who wishes.
शरण्ड: शरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. A bird in general. 	 2. A lizard, a chamæleon. 	 3. A kind of ornament. 	 4. A rogue, a cheat. 	 5. A libertine, a lecher. E. शॄ to injure, (fruit, &c.) अण्डच् Unādi aff.; also सरण्ड ।
शरण्य: शरण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) To be protected or aided, poor, miserable, helpless. 	 n. (-ण्यं) 	 1. A protection, a protector, that which or who affords refuge and defence. 	 2. A house. 	 3. Protection, defence. 	 4. Injury, hurt.  E. शृ to hurt, Unādi aff. अन्य; or शरण protection, and यत् aff. of fitness.
शरण्यु: शरण्यु m. (-ण्युः) 	 1. A plough. 	 2. Wind, air. 	 3. A protector, a defender. 4. A cloud.  E. शृ to injure, अन्यु aff.; also सरण्यु ।
शरत्कामिन्: शरत्कामिन् m. (-मी) A dog.  E. शरद् autumn, and कामिन् uxorious.
शरत्काल: शरत्काल n. (-लं) The autumnal season.  E. शरद् and काल time.
शरत्कालीन: शरत्कालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Autumnal.  E. शरत्काल and ख aff.
शरत्पर्वन्: शरत्पर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) A festival, on the full-moon of Āshwin, (September-October:) see कोजागर.  E. शरद् autumn, and पर्व्वन् a holy day.
शरत्पर्व्वन्: शरत्पर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) A festival, on the full-moon of Āshwin, (September-October:) see कोजागर.  E. शरद् autumn, and पर्व्वन् a holy day.
शरद्: शरद् f. (-रत् or रद्) 	 1. The season of autumn or the sultry season; the two months succeeding the rains; according to the VAIDIKAS, comprising the months BHĀDRA and ĀSHWIN, and according to the PAURĀNIKAS, ĀSHWIN and KĀRTIKA, fluctuating thus from AUGUST to NOVEMBER. 	 2. A year.  E. शॄ to injure, अदि Unādi aff.; also with टाप् added शरदा ।
शरदा: शरदा f. (-दा) 	 1. A year. 	 2. The sultry season. E. See the last.
शरदिज: शरदिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Autumnal, produced in Śarat or the season of autumn.  E. शरद् as above in the 7th case, and ज born.
शरधि: शरधि m. (-धिः) A quiver.  E. शर an arrow, धा to have or contain, aff. कि ।
शरन्मुख: शरन्मुख n. (-खं) Commencement of the autumn.  E. शरद्, मुख beginning.
शरपात: शरपात m. (-तः) An arrow's fall or flight.  E. शर and पात alighting.
शरपातस्थान: शरपातस्थान n. (-नं) A bowshot, an arrow's flight.  E. शरपात, स्थान place.
शरपुङ्खा: शरपुङ्खा f. (-ङ्खा) The feathered end of an arrow.  E. शर an arrow, and पुङ्ख the feathered part of it.
शरफल: शरफल n. (-लं) The blade or barb of an arrow.  E. शर, and फल blade.
शरभ: शरभ m. (-भः) 	 1. A fabulous animal, supposed to have eight legs, and to inhabit particularly the snowy mountains. 	 2. A young elephant. 3. A monkey in RĀMA'S army. 	 4. A camel. 	 5. A grasshopper. 	 6. A locust.  E. शॄ to injure, Unādi aff. अभच्; or शर an arrow, भा to shine, aff. क ।
शरभू: शरभू m. (-भूः) KĀRTIKEYA.  E. शर the grass, भू born; being reared in this grass.
शरमय: शरमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or consisting of Śara grass, &c.  E. शर the grass, and मयट् aff., implying in this and other compounds change of form for any purpose except food or clothing.

शराश्रय: शराश्रय m. (-यः) A quiver.  E. शर an arrow, आश्रय receptacle.
शरासन: शरासन n. (-नं) 	 1. A bow. 	 2. Shooting arrows.  E. शर, अस् to throw, aff. ल्युट् ।
शराहत: शराहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck by an arrow.  E. शर, and आहत struck.
शरिमन्: शरिमन् m. (-मा) Bearing, bringing forth.  E. शॄ to hurt, इमनिच् Unādi aff.

शरीरक: शरीरक n. (-कं) 	 1. A small or delicate body. 	 2. The body.  E. शरीर, and कन् diminutive, or pleonastic aff.

शरीरज: शरीरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced by the body, &c. 	 m. (-जः) 1. Sickness, disease. 	 2. The deity KĀMA or love. 	 3. A son.  E. शरीर the body, and ज born.
शरीरजन्मन्: शरीरजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Born or produced of or from the body.  E. शरीर, जन्मन् birth.

शरीरबद्ध: शरीरबद्ध Adj. Invested with a body.
शरीरबन्धक: शरीरबन्धक m. (-कः) A hostage.  E. शरीर, बन्धक a pledge.
शरीरभाज्: शरीरभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Embodied, corporeal, having body.  E. शरीर, भाज् who shares.
शरीरयष्टि: शरीरयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A slender body or figure.
शरीरयात्रा: शरीरयात्रा f. (-त्रा) Subsistence, support.  E. शरीर, and यात्रा going.
शरीरयोग: शरीरयोग m. (-गः) Bodily union.  E. शरीर, and योग union.
शरीरविमोक्षण: शरीरविमोक्षण n. (-णं) Liberation of the soul from the body.
शरीरशुश्रूषा: शरीरशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Personal attendance.  E. शरीर and शुश्रूषा service.
शरीरशोषण: शरीरशोषण n. (-णं) 	 1. Drying up, withering. 	 2. Emaciating the body. E. शरीर, and शोषण drying.
शरीरसंस्कार: शरीरसंस्कार m. (-रः) Purification of the body by various ceremonies at conception, birth, initiation, death, &c. 	 n. (-रं) Decoration or adorning the person.  E. शरीर and संस्कार making perfect.
शरीरावरण: शरीरावरण n. (-णं) The skin.  E. शरीर the body and आवरण enclosing.
शरीरिन्: शरीरिन् mfn. (-रि-रिणी-रि) Embodied, corporeal, having body. 	 m. (-री) An animal or sentiment being. 	 n. (-रि) Life or soul connected with the body, or incorporate.  E. शरीर the body and इनि aff.
शरु: शरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. Passion, anger. 	 2. The thunderbolt of INDRA. 	 3. An arrow. 	 4. Any weapon.  E. शॄ to injure, Unādi aff. उन् ।
शरेष्ट: शरेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The mango-tree.  E. शर an arrow and इष्ट desired; the blossoms of the mango being amongst those which tip the darts of CUPID.

शर्करावत्: शर्करावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Gritty, gravelly, full of stony particles. E. शर्करा gravel and मतुप् aff.
शर्करिक: शर्करिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Stony, gravelly.  E. शर्करा gravel, &c., ठज् aff.
शर्करिल: शर्करिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in stony or gravelly particles, (a spot, a place.)  E. शर्करा gravel and इलच् aff.
शर्करी: शर्करी f. (-री) 	 1. A river. 	 2. A girdle.
शर्ध्: शर्ध् r. 1st cl. (शर्धति) To wound or kill.

शर्ब्: शर्ब्ब् r. 1st cl. (शर्ब्बति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To hurt, to injure.
शर्ब्ब्: शर्ब्ब् r. 1st cl. (शर्ब्बति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To hurt, to injure.

शर्म्मद: शर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring prosperity, making happy, propitious. E. शर्म्मन् and द who or what gives.

शर्म्मन्: शर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Happy, glad. 	 n. (-र्म्म) Happiness, pleasure. 	 m. (-र्म्मा) A name or appellation common to and proper for Brāhmans. E. शॄ to injure or destroy, (ill fortune,) मनिन् Unādi aff.
शर्मवत्: शर्म्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Lucky, auspicious.  E. शर्म्मन् and मतुप् aff.
शर्म्मवत्: शर्म्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Lucky, auspicious.  E. शर्म्मन् and मतुप् aff.
शर्मर: शर्म्मर m. (-रः) A sort of garment or cloth. 	 f. (-रा) A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.)  E. शर्म्म pleasure, रा to give, aff. क ।
शर्म्मर: शर्म्मर m. (-रः) A sort of garment or cloth. 	 f. (-रा) A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.)  E. शर्म्म pleasure, रा to give, aff. क ।
शर्या: शर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Night.  E. शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
शर्य्या: शर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Night.  E. शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
शर्व्: शर्व्व् r. 1st cl. (शर्व्वति) To hurt, to injure or kill.
शर्व्व्: शर्व्व् r. 1st cl. (शर्व्वति) To hurt, to injure or kill.

शर्व्व: शर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) ŚIVA.  E. शर्व्व् to injure, Unādi aff. अच्; also सर्व ।

शर्व्वरी: शर्व्वरी f. (-री) 	 1. Night. 	 2. A woman. 	 3. Turmeric.  E. शॄ to injure, अरन् Unādi aff.; or शॄ-वनिप् ङीप् वनो र च ।
शर्वरीक: शर्व्वरीक m. (-कः) 	 1. A low or vile man, a rogue, a wretch. 	 2. A cruel or mischievous man.  E. शॄ to injure, ईकन् Unādi aff., रक् augment and the root repeated.
शर्व्वरीक: शर्व्वरीक m. (-कः) 	 1. A low or vile man, a rogue, a wretch. 	 2. A cruel or mischievous man.  E. शॄ to injure, ईकन् Unādi aff., रक् augment and the root repeated.
शर्वला: शर्व्वला f. (-ला or ली) An iron crow.  E. शर्व् to injure, कलच् aff.; also सर्व्वला ।
शर्व्वला: शर्व्वला f. (-ला or ली) An iron crow.  E. शर्व् to injure, कलच् aff.; also सर्व्वला ।
शर्वाणी: शर्व्वाणी f. (-णी) A name of PĀRVATĪ.  E. शर्व्व ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment; the wife of SARVA; also सर्व्वाणी ।
शर्व्वाणी: शर्व्वाणी f. (-णी) A name of PĀRVATĪ.  E. शर्व्व ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment; the wife of SARVA; also सर्व्वाणी ।
शल्: शल् r. 1st cl. (शलते) 	 1. To move, to shake, to tremble or stir. 	 2. To cover. (शलति) To go, to move to or towards. r. 10th cl. (शालयति-ते) To praise.
शल: शल mn. (-लः-लं) The quill of a porcupine. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A name of BHRINGI, ŚIVA'S attendant. 	 2. BRAHMĀ. 	 3. A kind of field. 	 4. A dart, a spear. 	 5. A stake. 	 6. A camel.  E. शल् to go, aff. अच् ।

शलल: शलल nf. (-लं-ली) The quill of a porcupine.  E. शल् to go, to project, aff. कलच्, fem. aff. ङीष् ।

शलालु: शलालु n. (-लुः) A sort of perfume.
शलालुक: शलालुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Purchased with or procured for the substance termed Śalālu.  E. शलालु as above, and ष्ठन् aff.
शल्क: शल्क n. (-ल्कं) 	 1. A part, a portion. 	 2. Bark, rind. 	 3. The scale of a fish.  E. शल् to go, Unādi aff. कन् ।
शल्कल: शल्कल n. (-लं) 	 1. The scale of a fish. 	 2. Bark, rind.  E. शल् to go, कलन् aff.
