शल्ल्: शल्ल् r. 1st cl. (शल्लति) To go or move.
शल्ल: शल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A frog. 	 n. (-ल्लं) Bark, rind.  E. शल् to go, लच् aff.; or शल्ल-अच् ।
शल्लक: शल्लक m. (-कः) 	 1. A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 	 n. (-कं) Bark, rind. 	 f. (-की) 	 1. A porcupine. 	 2. The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thuri-fera.)  E. शल् to go, aff. क्वुन्, deriv. irr.
शल्लकीद्रव: शल्लकीद्रव m. (-वः) Incense, Olibanum.  E. शल्लकी the Boswellia thurifera, द्रव exudation.
शल्व: शल्व m. (-ल्वः) A country so named in the north of India.  E. शल् to go, व aff.; more usually शाल्व ।
शव्: शव् r. 1st cl. (शवति) 	 1. To go or approach. 	 2. To change.
शव: शव mn. (-वः-वं) A dead body, a corpse. 	 n. (-वं) Water.  E. शव् to go, अच् aff.
शवकाम्य: शवकाम्य m. (-म्यः) A dog.  E. शव a corpse, and काम्य desirous.
शवदाह: शवदाह m. (-हः) Burning a corpse.  E. शव, दाह burning.
शवदाहिन्: शवदाहिन् m. (-ही) A person who burns a corpse.  E. शव, दाहिन् who burns.
शवयान: शवयान n. (-नं) The litter or bed on which a dead body is carried to be burnt.  E. शव a corpse, and यान a vehicle.
शवर: शवर m. (-रः) 	 1. A barbarian, one inhabiting the mountainous districts of India, and wearing the feathers of the peacock, &c. as decora-tions. 	 2. Water. 	 3. A name of ŚIVA. 	 4. The hand. 	 5. Name of a learned writer on Mimānsā Darshan.  E. शव a corpse, रा to take, affs. क and टाप्: or शव्-अरन् ।
शवराल: शवराल m. (-लः) A sort of Lodh.
शवरालय: शवरालय m. (-यः) The abode of an outcaste or low tribe.  E. शवर a ber-barian, आलय abode.
शवरावास: शवरावास m. (-सः) The abode of an outcaste or barbarous tribe.  E. शवर a barbarian, आवास abode.
शवल: शवल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Variegated, of a variegated colour. 	 2. Imita-tive. 	 3. Articulate. 	 4. Divided into various parts. 	 m. (-लः) A varie-gated colour. 	 f. (-ला-ली) 	 1. A brindled cow. 	 2. The cow of plenty, KĀMADHENU. 	 n. (-ल) 	 1. Water 2. A religious observance peculiar to the Bauddhas.  E. शव् to alter, कलन् aff, and प changed to व ।
शवलता: शवलता f. (-ता) Variegation, variety of colour.  E. शवल and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शवलत्वं ।
शवलीकृत: शवलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated.  E. शवल, कृत made. च्वि augment.
शवसाधन: शवसाधन n. (-नं) A mystical and magical ceremony performed with a dead body.  E. शव, and साधन implement.
शवसान: शवसान m. (-नः) 	 1. A traveller, (in the dialect of the Vedas.) 	 2. A road. 	 n. (-नं) A cemetery.  E. शव् to go, with आनच् aff.
शश्: शश् r. 1st cl. (शशति) To jump, to leap, to move by springing or leaping.
शश: शश m. (-शः) 	 1. A hare or rabbit. 	 2. The Lodh-tree, (Symplocos race-mosa.) 	 3. Gum myrrh. 	 4. A man of mild and virtuous character, but uxorious and woman-led, one of the four characters in which men are classed by erotic writers. 	 5. The spots on the moon, sup-posed to resemble the figure of a hare.  E. शश् to go by leaps or jumps, aff. अच् ।
शशक: शशक m. (-कः) A hare.  E. कन् added to the last.
शशत्: शशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Leaping, jumping.  E. शश् to leap, शतृ aff.
शशधर: शशधर m. (-रः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor.  E. शश a hare, and धर having; either as an emblem on his banners, or fancifully, as the spots on the moon's face.
शशप्लुतक: शशप्लुतक n. (-कं) A mark or scratch of the finger-nail.  E. शश a hare, प्लुतक jumping.
शशबिन्दु: शशबिन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 	 1. VISHṆU or KRISHṆA. 	 2. A sovereign. 	 3. The moon.  E. शश a hare, and बिन्दु a spot.
शशभृत्: शशभृत् m. (-भृत्) The moon.  E. शश a hare, भृत् who cherishes: see शशधर ।
शशमात्र: शशमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) As large as or of the size of a hare.  E. शश, मात्रच् aff.
शशलाञ्छन: शशलाञ्छन m. (-नः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor.  E. शश, लाञ्छन mark.
शशलोमन्: शशलोमन् n. (-म) The skin of the hare or rabbit.  E. शश a hare or rabbit, लोमन् hair.
शशविषाण: शशविषाण n. (-णं) The horn of a hare; any thing improbable or extra-ordinary.  E. शश, विषाण a horn.
शशस्थली: शशस्थली f. (-ली) The Doab, the country between the Ganges and Jamunā rivers.  E. शश a hare, स्थल place, site.
शशाङ्क: शशाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor.  E. शश a hare, अङ्क a mark or spot.
शशाङ्कलेखा: शशाङ्कलेखा f. (-खा) A digit of the moon.  E. शशाङ्क, लेखा streak.
शशादन: शशादन m. (-नः) A hawk or falcon.  E. शश a hare or rabbit, अदन what eats.
शशिकान्त: शशिकान्त m. (-न्तः) The moon-gem. 	 n. (-न्तं) A lotus.
शशिग्रह: शशिग्रह m. (-हः) An eclipse of the moon.
शशिज: शशिज m. (-जः) An epithet of BUDHA or MERCURY.
शशिदेव: शशिदेव m. (-वः) A sovereign, named also रन्तिदेव ।
शशिन्: शशिन् m. (-शी) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. The emblem of one of the Jinas. 	 3. Camphor.  E. शश a hare, इनि aff.
शशिपाद: शशिपाद m. (-दः) A moon-beam.  E. शशि, and पाद a ray; also similar compounds, as शशिकर, शशिकिरण, शशिमयूख and शशिरश्मि, &c.
शशिप्रभ: शशिप्रभ n. (-भं) The white esculent water-lily. 	 f. (-भा) Moon-light. E. शशि the moon, प्रभ shining, (blossoming,) or प्रभा lustre, light.
शशिलेखा: शशिलेखा f. (-खा) 	 1. A digit of the moon. 	 2. A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 	 3. A metre, a variety of the line of the Atijagatī stanza of thirteen syllables, or of the Atisaccarī of fifteen syllables. E. शशि the moon, and लेखा a line or mark.
शशिवदना: शशिवदना f. (-ना) 	 1. A woman with a face like the moon. 	 2. A species of the Gāyatri metre.  E. शशि, वदन face.
शशिशेखर: शशिशेखर m. (-रः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. One of the Jaina pontiffs.  E. शशि the moon, शेखर a crest.
शशीश: शशीश m. (-शः) A name of ŚIVA.  E. शशि, ईश lord.
शशोर्ण: शशोर्ण n. (-र्णं) The hair of the hare or rabbit.  E. शश a hare, &c., ऊर्णा wool.
शश्वत्: शश्वत् Ind. 	 1. Again and again, frequently, repeatedly, perpetually. 	 2. Together with  E. शश् to go by jumps, वति aff.
शष्: शष् r. 1st cl. (शषति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
शष्कुल: शष्कुल m. (-लः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea, Rox) 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. The outer ear or opening of the external auditory passage. 	 2. Rice or barley water, &c. 	 3. A sort of pie. 	 4. A kind of baked cake.  E. शष्-कुलच् ।
शष्प: शष्प n. (-ष्पं) Young grass. 	 m. (-ष्पः) Loss of intellect or confidence.  E. शस् to hurt, Unādi aff. प, and स changed to ष; also शस्प.
शस्: शस्(इ) and the preposition आङ् usually prefixed आशसि r. 1st cl. (आशंसते) 	 1. To bless, to wish good to, to confer a benediction. 	 2. To wish, to desire. 	 3. To speak. (उ) शसु r. 1st cl. (शसति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. With अभि, To intreat. With वि, To kill. r. 2nd cl. शस्ति To dream.
शसन: शसन n. (-नं) Immolation, offering an animal in sacrifice.  E. शस् to hurt, aff. ल्युट्; also शमन ।
शस्त: शस्त(इ)शस्ति r. 2nd cl. (शंस्ति) To sleep, (peculiar to the Vedas.)

शस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 	 1. Happy, well, right. 	 2. Praised, eulogised. 	 3. Best, excellent. 	 4. Injured. 	 n. (-स्तं) 	 1. Happiness, excellence. 	 2. The body. 	 3. A finger-protector.  E. शस् to bless, aff. क्त ।
शस्तक: शस्तक n. (-कं) A defence for the finger of an archer.  E. कन् added to the last.
शस्तकेशक: शस्तकेशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having much or beautiful hair.  E. शस्त excellent, केश hair, कन् aff.
शस्त्र: शस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 	 1. A weapon in general. 	 2. Iron. 	 3. Steel. 	 4. An instru-ment. 	 5. A hymn of praise. 	 m. (-स्त्रः) A sword, a scymitar. 	 f. (-स्त्री) A knife.  E. शस् to hurt, aff. ष्ट्रन् ।
शस्त्रक: शस्त्रक n. (-कं) 	 1. Iron. 	 2. Steel.  E. शस्त्र a weapon, and कन् aff.
शस्त्रकार: शस्त्रकार m. (-रः) An armourer.  E. शस्त्र, and कार who makes.
शस्त्रग्रह: शस्त्रग्रह m. (-हः) Taking arms.  E. शस्त्र and ग्रह taking.
शस्त्रग्राहिन्: शस्त्रग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A man armed.  E. शस्त्र, ग्राहिन् who takes.
शस्त्रघुष्टकर: शस्त्रघुष्टकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Clanging.  E. शस्त्र, घुष्ट sounded, कर what makes.
शस्त्रजाल: शस्त्रजाल n. (-लं) A quantity of weapons.  E. शस्त्र, जाल a heap.
शस्त्रजीविन्: शस्त्रजीविन् m. (-वी) A soldier by profession.  E. शस्त्र a weapon, जीविन् who lives by.
शस्त्रत्याग: शस्त्रत्याग m. (-गः) Throwing away a weapon.  E. शस्त्र, त्याग abandoning.
शस्त्रधर: शस्त्रधर m. (-रः) An armed man or soldier.  E. शस्त्र, and धर who has.
शस्त्रपाणि: शस्त्रपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) A warrior armed, having weapons in the hand.  E. शस्त्र, and पाणि the hand.
शस्त्रपात: शस्त्रपात m. (-तः) The stroke of a weapon.  E. शस्त्र, and पात falling.
शस्त्रपूत: शस्त्रपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purified by arms, absolved from guilt by dying in the field of battle.  E. शस्त्र, and पूत purified.
शस्त्रप्रहरण: शस्त्रप्रहरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Taking arms.  E. शस्त्र, प्रहरण taking.
शस्त्रभृत्: शस्त्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) An armed man, a soldier.  E. शस्त्र a weapon, भृत् having.
शस्त्रमार्ज: शस्त्रमार्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) An armourer.  E. शस्त्र a weapon, and मार्ज्ज cleaning.
शस्त्रमार्ज्ज: शस्त्रमार्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) An armourer.  E. शस्त्र a weapon, and मार्ज्ज cleaning.
शस्त्रवृत्ति: शस्त्रवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A soldier, a man at arms.  E. शस्त्र, and वृत्ति profession.
शस्त्रसंहति: शस्त्रसंहति f. (-तिः) 	 1. A quantity or number of weapons. 	 2. An arsenal, an armoury.  E. शस्त्र, and संहति assemblage.
शस्त्रसमूह: शस्त्रसमूह n. (-ह) 	 1. A quantity or number of weapons. 	 2. An arsenal, an armoury.  E. शस्त्र, and समूह a heap.
शस्त्रहत: शस्त्रहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck or killed by a weapon.  E. शस्त्र, हत hurt.
शस्त्रहस्त: शस्त्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) A man carrying arms.  E. शस्त्र a weapon, हस्त the hand.
शस्त्राजीव: शस्त्राजीव m. (-वः) A soldier.  E. शस्त्र a weapon, आजीव who lives by.
शस्त्राभ्यास: शस्त्राभ्यास m. (-सः) Military exercise or practice.  E. शस्त्र a weapon, and अभ्यास practice.
शस्त्रास्त्र: शस्त्रास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Use of weapons.  E. शस्त्र, अस्त्र a weapon, or means of offence or defence.
शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्: शस्त्रास्त्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) A soldier, a warrior.  E. शस्त्रास्त्र, भृत् who has.
शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्त्व: शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The military profession, the use of arms. E. शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्, त्व aff.
शस्त्रिन्: शस्त्रिन् mfn. (-स्त्री-स्त्रिणी-स्त्रि) Armed, having weapons.  E. शस्त्र, इनि aff.
शस्त्रोत्थापन: शस्त्रोत्थापन n. (-नं) Raising a weapon, (as to strike.)  E. शस्त्र, उत्थापन taking up.
शस्त्रोद्यम: शस्त्रोद्यम m. (-मः) Lifting up a weapon, (as to strike.)  E. शस्त्र, and उद्यन lifting up.
शस्त्रोपजीविन्: शस्त्रोपजीविन् m. (-वी) A soldier, a man at arms.  E. शस्त्र, उपजीविन् living by.
शस्प: शस्प n. (-स्पं) 	 1. Young grass. 	 2. Loss of confidence or understanding. E. शस् to injury, प aff., and the sibilant unchanged.
शस्य: शस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 	 1. Excellent, best. 	 2. To be hurt or injured. 	 3. Desirable, to be wished. 	 n. (-स्यं) 	 1. Fruit. 	 2. Corn, grain in general. 	 3. Good quantity, merit. 	 4. Grass.  E. शस् to hurt, aff. यत्; or शसि to wish, क्यप् aff.
शस्यक्षेत्र: शस्यक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) A corn-field.  E. शस्य, and क्षेत्र a field.
शस्यध्वंसिन्: शस्यध्वंसिन् m. (-सी) A timber tree, commonly Toon, (Cedrela tunna.) “तुंँद् गाछ ।”  E. शस्य fruit, and ध्वंसिन् injurious.
शस्यभक्षक: शस्यभक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Graminivorous.  E. शस्य, and भक्षक what eats.
शस्यभक्षण: शस्यभक्षण n. (-णं) Feeding upon grain.  E. शस्य, भक्षण eating.
शस्यमञ्जरी: शस्यमञ्जरी f. (-री) 	 1. The ear or spike of corn. 	 2. The fruit-stalk. E. शस्य and सञ्जरी pedicle.
शस्यरक्षक: शस्यरक्षक m. (-कं) A watchman over a field of corn.  E. शस्य, रक्षक who protects.
शस्यशूक: शस्यशूक n. (-कं) The beard of corn.  E. शस्य corn, शूक beard.
शस्यसम्बर: शस्यसम्बर m. (-रः) The Sāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)  E. शस्य fruit, सम्बर surrounding.
शस्यारु: शस्यारु m. (-रुः) A small variety of the Mimosa suma.
शांशप: शांशप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Made of Śisu wood, &c.  E. शिंशपा the Śisu, अण् aff., and आङ् substituted for the first vowel.
शाक: शाक mn. (-कः-कं) A pot-herb in general, any leaf, flower, fruit, stalk, root, &c., used as a vegetable. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. One of the seven Dvīpas or divisions of the world; the sixth, surrounded by the sea of milk or white sea. 	 2. Power, strength. 	 3. The Sirisha-tree, (Acacia sirisa.) 	 4. The Teak-tree, (Tectona grandis.) 	 5. An era, a period usually commencing with some celebrated prince, as YUDISHṬHIRA VIKRAMĀDITYA, ŚĀLIVĀHANA, &c., thence denominated SĀKE-ŚWARAS, &c.; the term in ordinary use is applied especially to the era of SĀLIVĀHANA, commencing 76 or 78 years after the Christian era.  E. शक् to be able, घञ् aff.
शाकट: शाकट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) Relating to a cart, (a cart-load, a cart-horse, &c.) m. (-टः) 	 1. A draught-ox. 	 2. The Sleshmāntaka-tree.  E. शकट a cart, अण् aff.
शाकटायन: शाकटायन m. (-नः) Name of a philologist and grammarian.
शाकटिक: शाकटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going in or on a cart.  E. शकट a cart, ठञ् aff.
शाकटीन: शाकटीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Belonging or relating to a cart. 	 m. (-नः) A cart-load as a measure of weight or value.  E. शकट a cart, खञ् aff.
शाकपण: शाकपण m. (-णः) A handful or similar quantity, as a measure of potherbs.  E. शाक, and पण price.
शाकबालेय: शाकबालेय m. (-यः) A plant, commonly Bāmanhāti; also बालेयशाक ।
शाकबिल्व: शाकबिल्व m. (-ल्वः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.)  E. शाक a potherb, बिल्व the Bel fruit; also with कन् added शाकबिल्वक ।
शाकम्भरी: शाकम्भरी f. (-री) 	 1. DURGĀ. 	 2. A city, supposed to be the modern Sāmbher.  E. शक a potherb, भृ to nourish, aff. खच्, fem. aff. ङीष् ।
शाकम्भरीय: शाकम्भरीय n. (-यं) A fossile-salt brought from a lake in the vicinity of Sāmbher, a town in Ajmere.  E. शाकम्भरी the city, छ aff.
शाकरी: शाकरी f. (-री) One of the dialects of dramatic Prakrit, that spoken by the Sakāra.  E. शकार, अण् and ङीष् aff.
शाकलिक: शाकलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having a piece or part.  E. शकल a part, ठञ् aff.
शाकल्य: शाकल्य m. (-ल्यः) Name of an ancient grammarian who preceded PĀNINI.
शाकवीर: शाकवीर m. (-रः) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)  E. शक a potherb, and वीर eminent.
शाकवृक्ष: शाकवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Teak-tree.  E. शाक the same, and वृक्ष a tree.
शाकशाकट: शाकशाकट n. (-टं) A field of vegetables, a kitchen garden.  E. शाक a potherb, and शाकटच् aff. in this sense.
शाकशाकिन: शाकशाकिन n. (-नं) A field cultivated for esculent plants, a field of vege-tables, a kitchen-garden.  E. शाक a vegetable, and शाकिन aff. in this sense.
शाकश्रेष्ठ: शाकश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.  E. शाक a potherb, and श्रेष्ठ best.
शाकाख्य: शाकाख्य m. (-ख्यः) The Teak-tree. 	 n. (-ख्यं) A vegetable.  E. शाक the same, आख्या appellation.
शाकाङ्ग: शाकाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Pepper.  E. शाक a potherb, and अङ्ग a part.
शाकिनी: शाकिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A female divinity of an inferior character, attendant especially on ŚIVA and DURGĀ. 	 2. A field of vegetables.  E. शाक, इनि aff.
शाकुण: शाकुण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Repentant, regretting.  E. शक-वा० उणन् ।
शाकुन: शाकुन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 	 1. Of or relating to birds. 	 2. Ominous, portentous. E. शकुन, अण् aff.
शाकुनिक: शाकुनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to birds, omens, &c. 	 m. (-कः) A fowler, a bird-catcher. 	 n. (-कं) Interpretation of omens, dreams, &c.  E. शकुन a bird, and ठञ् aff.
शाकुन्तलेय: शाकुन्तलेय m. (-यः) BHARATA, the sovereign of India.  E. शकुन्तला the nymph, and ढक् aff; being the son of ŚAKUNTALĀ and DUSHYANTA.
शाकुलिक: शाकुलिक m. (-कः) A fisherman.  E. शकुल a fish, and ठक् aff.
शाक्कर: शाक्कर m. (-रः) An ox. 	 n. (-रं) A form of metre.  E. शक्कर, and अञ् aff.
शाक्त: शाक्त m. (-क्तः) A worshipper of the female principle.  E. शक्ति the divine energy in its feminine personification, and अण् aff.
शाक्तीक: शाक्तीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Speared, spearing, relating to or done with a spear. 	 m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer.  E. शक्ति a spear, aff. ईकक् ।
शाक्त्य: शाक्त्य m. (-क्त्यः) A worshipper of the female principle or Śakti.  E. शक्ति the personified energy of a divinity, and यञ् aff.
शाक्य: शाक्य m. (-क्यः) 	 1. BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion. 	 2. The name of a tribe.  E. शक् to be able, and ण्यत्, घञ् or यत् aff.
शाक्यमुनि: शाक्यमुनि m. (-निः) A name of BUDDHA, the real or supposed founder of the Bauddha religion.  E. शक्य said to be the name of a family or tribe, originating with one of the race of Ikswāku, condemned to take up his abode in a forest of Sāka trees, and मुनि a saint.
शाक्यसिंह: शाक्यसिंह m. (-हः) A name of BUDDHA.  E. शाक्य the name of his tribe, and सिंह chief.
शाक्री: शाक्री f. (-क्री) An epithet of ŚACHĪ, the wife of INDRA.
शाक्वर: शाक्वर m. (-रः) An ox.  E. शक्-ष्वरप् स्वार्थे अण् ।
शाख: शाख m. (-खः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea.) 	 f. (-खा) 	 1. A branch, the branch of a tree. 	 2. A branch or sub-division of the Vedas, consis-ting of the several Sanhitās or collections of prayers in each Veda, as received in different schools, modified more or less either in the arrangement of the whole text, or in particular portions of it. 	 3. An arm. 	 4. A sect, a faction, a party. 	 5. Any sub-division. 	 6. Any part of an animal not endowed with sensibility, as a horn, &c. E. शाख् to pervade, aff. अच् ।
शाखाचन्द्रन्याय: शाखाचन्द्रन्याय m. (-यः) The maxim of the moon and a bough; it is adduced in illustration when an object has its position assigned to it from the appearance of contiguity.
शाखानगर: शाखानगर n. (-रं) A suburb.  E. शाखा a branch or sub-division, नगर a city.
शाखापित्त: शाखापित्त m. (-त्तः) Inflammation of the extremities of the body.
शाखापुर: शाखापुर n. (-रं) A suburb.  E. शाखा a branch, पुर a city.
शाखाभेद: शाखाभेद m. (-दः) Difference of school or doctrine.  E. शाखा, भेद difference.
शाखामृग: शाखामृग m. (-गः) 	 1. A monkey, an ape. 	 2. A squirrel.  E. शाखा the branch of a tree, मृग a deer.
शाखारण्ड: शाखारण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A Brāhman who has changed his Śākhā or pecu-liar school of the Vedas for another.  E. शाखा a branch of the Vedas, रम् to sport, ड aff.
शाखाल: शाखाल m. (-लः) A sort of cane: see वानीर ।
शाखाशिफा: शाखाशिफा f. (-फा) A root proceeding from a branch, as in the Indian fig, the branches of which shoot downwards to the ground and take fresh root there.  E. शाखा a branch, and शिफा a fibrous root.
शाखिन्: शाखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Branched, branching, having branches. (literally or figuratively.) 	 m. (-खी) 	 1. A tree. 	 2. Veda. 	 3. A follower of any vedic school. 	 4. An inhabitant of the northern districts bordering on India, a Turk or Tartar. 	 5. The name of a king. E. शाखा a branch, aff. इनि ।
शाखोट: शाखोट m. (-टः) A small tree, (Trophis aspera.)  E. शाख्, ओटन् aff.; also with कन् added शाखोटक m. (-कः) ।
शाख्य: शाख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Branching, ramifying.  E. शाखा a branch, (literally or figuratively,) and य aff.
शाङ्कर: शाङ्कर m. (-रः) A bull. 	 n. (-रं) A form of metre.  E. शङ्कर ŚIVA, and अण् aff.; also read शाक्कर ।
शाङ्करि: शाङ्करि m. (-रिः) 	 1. KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. GAṆEŚA. 	 3. Fire. 	 4. A Muni. E. शङ्कर ŚIVA, and इञ patronymic aff.
शाङ्कुची: शाङ्कुची f. (-ची) The scate fish; also शंकुची, &c.
शाङ्क: शाङ्क n. (-ङ्कं) The sound of the conch-shell.  E. शङ्कं the shell, अण् aff.
शाङ्किक: शाङ्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made from, relating to, &c. the Śankha or conch. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A shell-cutter, a worker in shells. 	 2. A player on the Śankha, a shell-blower.  E. शङ्क the conch-shell, ठञ् aff.
शाट: शाट m. (-टः) A garment in general.  E. शट्-घञ् ।
शाटक: शाटक mn. (-कः-कं) A petticoat.  E. शट् to go, (round the limbs,) ण्वुल् aff.
शाटी: शाटी mf. (-टः-टी) A petticoat.  E. शट् to praise or flatter, to go, &c. aff. ण, fem. aff ङीष् ।
शाठ्य: शाठ्य n. (-ठ्यं) Wickedness, villainy.  E. शठ् wicked, ष्यञ् aff.
शाड्: शाड्(ऋ)शाडृ r. 1st cl. (शाडते) 	 1. To flatter, to praise, to coax. 	 2. To boast. 	 3. To float or swim.
शाड्वल: शाड्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in fresh grass, green, verdant. E. शाद young grass, ड्वलच् aff., and the final changed, also शाद्वल ।
शाण: शाण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Made of or from Bengal flax or Śaṇ. 	 mf. (-णः-णी) 1. A touchstone. 	 2. A whet or grindstone. 	 3. A weight of four Māshas. 	 4. A saw. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. Coarse cloth, sack-cloth, canvas. 	 2. A hempen garment. 	 f. (-णी) 	 1. Ragged or torn raiment. 	 2. A new unseamed and single-breadth of cloth, given to the religious student at his investiture for his upper garment. 	 3. A ragged garment given to the Jaina ascetic at his initiation. 	 4. A small tent or screen, used especially as a retiring room for actors and tumblers, &c. 	 5. Gesture, gesticulation, making sings with the hands or eyes, &c. 	 6. A saw. 	 7. A touchstone. 	 8. A whetstone. E. शण् to give, aff. घञ्; or शो to sharpen, and ण aff.; or शण Śaṇ, and अण् aff. of derivation.
शाणाजीव: शाणाजीव m. (-वः) An armourer.  E. शाण a whetstone, आजीव who lives by.
शाणि: शाणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. A plant from the fibres of which a coarse cloth is prepared, (Corchorus olitorius.) 	 2. A touchstone.  E. शण Bengal Śaṇ, and इण् or ईञ् aff. implying descent or resemblance.
शाणित: शाणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Whetted, sharpened.  E. शण् to give, क्त aff.
शाण्डिल्य: शाण्डिल्य m. (-ल्यः) 	 1. A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) 	 2. A Muni from whom one of the three principal families of the Kanouj or Kānyacubja Brāhmans is said to be descended. 	 3. A form of AGNI or fire. E. शण्डिल a saint, यञ् aff. of descent, &c.
शात: शात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Happy, well, prosperous. 	 2. Feeble, thin. 	 3. Sharpened, whetted, sharp. 	 4. Handsome, bright. 	 n. (-तं) Joy, pleasure, happiness.  E. शो to reduce or diminish, aff. क्त ।
शातकुम्भ: शातकुम्भ n. (-म्भं) Gold. 	 m. (-म्भः) A plant, (Nerium odorum.)  E. शतकुम्भ said to be the name of a mountain, अण् aff. implying production.
शातकौम्भ: शातकौम्भ n. (-म्भं) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. The Dhuturā plant.  E. अण् pleonasm, added to the last.
शातन: शातन n. (-णं) 	 1. Withering, decaying, becoming thin or small. 	 2. Sharpening.  E. शो to wither, णिच् तङ् च, aff. ल्युट् ।
शातपत्रकी: शातपत्रकी f. (-की) Moonlight.  E. शतपत्र a lotus, कन् added, and अण् aff.
शातमन्यव: शातमन्यव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating to INDRA.  E. शतमन्यु, and अण् aff.
शातमान: शातमान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Bought with the measure of one hundred.  E. शत a hundred, मान measure, and अण् aff.
शातशिख: शातशिख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Sharp-pointed, (as the nails, &c.)  E. शात, and शिखा crest.
शातोदरी: शातोदरी f. (-री) A woman with a small belly or waist.  E. शात, and उदर the belly, ङीप् aff.
शात्रव: शात्रव m. (-वः) An enemy. 	 n. (-वं) 	 1. Enmity, hostility. 	 2. A multitude of enemies. 	 f. (-वी) Hostile.  E. शत्रु an enemy, and अण् pleonasm, or aff. of quality or number.
शात्रवीय: शात्रवीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Hostile, inimical, belonging or relating to an enemy.  E. शात्रव, and छ aff.
शाद: शाद m. (-दः) 	 1. Mud. 	 2. Young grass.  E. शद्-घञ् aff.
शादहरित: शादहरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Green or fresh with young grass.  E. शाद young grass, हरित green.
शाद्वल: शाद्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in fresh or green grass.  E. शाद young grass, ड्वलच् aff.
शान्: शान् r. 1st cl. intensitive form (शीशांसति-ते) To whet, to sharpen.
शान: शान m. (-नः) 	 1. A touchstone. 	 2. A grindstone. 	 f. (-नी) A sort of cucumber.  E. शो to make small or sharpen, aff. ल्युट्; also शाण ।
शानपाद: शानपाद m. (-दः) A stone for grinding sandal.
शान्त: शान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 	 1. Calm, tranquil, pacified. 	 2. Allayed, alleviated. 3. Meek, humble. 	 4. Purified, cleansed, freed from, (as soil.) 	 5. Stilled, hushed, (as wind, &c.) 	 m. (-न्तः) 	 1. An ascetic, one whose passions are subdued and who is engrossed by meditating on the deity. 	 2. One of the Rasas or conditions of feeling, delineated in poetry or the drama, tranquillity or tranquil devotion, quietism, the assiduous exercise of meditation, &c. and indifference to all objects of pleasure or pain. 	 n. (-न्तं) Appeasing, pacifying. Ind. (शान्तम्) A prohibitive particle or interjection, implying negation, aversion, disgust, (fie! for shame! Heaven forbid!)  E. शम् to be appeased, aff. क्त ।
शान्तचेतस्: शान्तचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) Composed, calm, unanxious.  E. शान्त, and चेतस् mind.
शान्तता: शान्तता f. (-ता) Quietness, calmness, meekness.  E. शान्त, तल् aff.; also with त्व, शान्तत्वं ।
शान्तनव: शान्तनव m. (-वः) BHĪSHMA, the reputed great uncle of the Pāndavas. E. शान्तनु a prince, and अण् aff. of descent.
शान्तनु: शान्तनु m. (-नुः) The 21st sovereign of the lunar dynasty in the third age, the father of BHĪSHMA by Gangā, or the Ganges personified. E. शं good fortune, (personified,) तनु the body, and the first vowel made long by special rule.
शान्तमल: शान्तमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Exempt from soil, literally or figuratively.  E. शान्त cleansed, and मल dirt.
शान्तरय: शान्तरय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Slackened in speed.  E. शान्त, रय rapidity.
शान्तरस: शान्तरस m. (-सः) The sentiment of quietism.
शान्तविवाद: शान्तविवाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Reconciled, appeased.  E. शान्त, and विवाद dispute.
शान्तात्मन्: शान्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Calm, composed, of resigned or composed spirit.  E. शान्त, and आत्मन् self.
शान्तार्चिस्: शान्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Extinguished, put or gone out.  E. शान्त, अर्च्चिस् flame.
शान्तार्च्चिस्: शान्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Extinguished, put or gone out.  E. शान्त, अर्च्चिस् flame.
शान्ति: शान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 	 1. Quiet, tranquillity, stoicism, the absence of passion, and indifference to objects of pleasure or pain; it is especially applied to the tranquillity of devotion, or quietism, by which the mind is wholly fixed on the subject of its meditation or worship, and is utterly disregardless of external impressions. 	 2. Good-fortune, auspiciousness, felicity. 	 3. Rest, repose. 	 4. Expiatory or propitiatory rites to avert any evil. 	 5. Preliminary ceremonies to avert inauspicious accidents at any religious celebration. 	 6. Remission, alleviation. 	 m. (-न्तिः) 	 1. The sixteenth Jina or Jaina deified sage of the present, era. 	 2. One of the Jaina emperors of the universe.  E. शम् to be appeased, aff. क्तिन् ।
शान्तिक: शान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Propitiatory, expiatory. 	 2. Producing ease or quiet, &c. 	 3. Relating to quiet, &c. 	 n. (-कं) Ceremonies for the removal of calamities.  E. शान्ति, and ठक् aff.
शान्तिकर: शान्तिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Tranquillising, calming, appeasing, &c.  E. शान्ति and कर who or what makes.
शान्तिकर्तृ: शान्तिकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Conferring tranquillity, calming, appeasing. m. (-र्त्ता) Any divinity who averts evil.  E. शान्ति, कर्त्तृ who makes.
शान्तिकर्त्तृ: शान्तिकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Conferring tranquillity, calming, appeasing. m. (-र्त्ता) Any divinity who averts evil.  E. शान्ति, कर्त्तृ who makes.
शान्तिकाम: शान्तिकाम m. (-मः) Desire of tranquillity and exemption from calamity. E. शान्ति peace, and काम desire.
शान्तिगृह: शान्तिगृह n. (-ह) A private apartment near the place of sacrifice.  E. शान्ति devotion, गृह a house.
शान्तिद: शान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Tranquillising, calming, allaying.  E. शान्ति, द who or what gives.
शान्तिहोम: शान्तिहोम m. (-मः) Burnt offerings, to prevent threatening or possible evils.  E. शान्ति, and हाम burnt offering.
शान्त्युद: शान्त्युद n. (-दं) Water offered at sacrifices for propitiation.  E. शान्ति, and उद water; also शान्त्युदकं ।
शान्त्युदकुम्भ: शान्त्युदकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A vessel holding lustral water.  E. शान्त्युद, and कुम्भ a jar.
शान्त्व: शान्त्व r. 10th cl. (शान्त्वयति) To console, to comfort.
शान्त्व n. (-न्त्वं) 	 1. Conciliation. 	 2. Comforting, consoling.  E. शम् to appease or allay, (opposition,) deriv. irr.; or शान्त्व to console, aff. अच्; also सान्त्व ।
शाप: शाप m. (-पः) 	 1. Oath, affirmation by oath or ordeal. 	 2. Curse, impreca-tion. 	 3. Abuse.  E. शप् to swear, aff. घञ् ।
शापग्रस्त: शापग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Having incurred or suffering under a curse. E. शाप, ग्रस्त seized.
शापज: शापज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Arising from a curse, being the effect of one.  E. शाप, ज born.
शापमुक्त: शापमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Freed from a curse.  E. शाप, and मुक्त released.
शापान्त: शापान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a curse or period of an imprecation.  E. शाप, and अन्त end.
शापास्त्र: शापास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) A Muni, a saint.  E. शाप a curse, and अस्त्र a weapon; a curse denounced by such a personage, being formidable even to the deities.
शापित: शापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sworn, made to take an oath.  E. शप् to swear, causal v., क्त aff.
शापोद्धार: शापोद्धार m. (-रः) Deliverance from a curse or its effects.  E. शाप, and उद्धार extricating.
शाफरिक: शाफरिक m. (-कः) A fisherman.  E. शफर a kind of fish, put for any, and ठक् aff.
शाब्द: शाब्द mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दी-ब्दं) 	 1. Sonorous, sounding. 	 2. Nominal, (as inflec-tion.) 	 f. (-ब्दी) 	 1. SARASWATĪ, goddess of speech and eloquence. 	 2. Relating to or derived from a word. 	 3. Relating to sound, (as opposed to आर्थ.)  E. शब्द sound or a word, and अण् attributive aff.
शाब्दिक: शाब्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to sounds or words. 	 m. (-कः) A profi-cient in the senses and forms of nouns or words.  E. शब्द a sound, and ठक् aff.
शामन्: शामन् n. (-मं) Conciliation, appeasing, reconciling.  E. शम् to appease, aff. मनिन्, and the vowel made long; also शामन ।
शामन: शामन n. (-नं) 	 1. Killing, slaughter. 	 2. Tranquillity, peace. 	 m. (-नः) An epithet of YAMA.  E. शम् to be pacified, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
शामित्र: शामित्र n. (-त्रं) 	 1. Sacrificing. 	 2. Tying up cattle for sacrifice. 	 3. A sacrificial vessel.  E. शम् to appease, इत्रच् aff.
शामीन: शामीन n. (-नं) Ashes f. (-नी) A Sacrificial spoon.  E. शम् ईनञ् aff.
शाम्बरी: शाम्बरी f. (-री) 	 1. A female-juggler. 	 2. Jugglery, sorcery.  E. शम्बर a demon, अण् added, and ङीष् fem. aff.
शाम्बविक: शाम्बविक m. (-कः) A worker in shells.  E. शम्बु a shell, ठक् aff.
शाम्बुक: शाम्बुक m. (-कः) A bivalve-shell.  E. अण् pleonasm added to शम्बु; also read शाम्बूक, &c.
शाम्भव: शाम्भव m. (-वः) 	 1. A sort of poison. 	 2. A worshipper of ŚIVA. 	 3. The son of ŚAMBHU or ŚIVA. 	 4. Camphor. 	 n. (-वं) The Devadāru tree. f. (-वी) PĀRVATI.  E. शम्भु a name of ŚIVA, अण् aff.
शायक: शायक m. (-कः) 	 1. An arrow. 	 2. A sword.  E. शी to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.; also सायक ।
शायिका: शायिका f. (-का) Sleeping.  E. शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.
शायिन्: शायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Lying down.  E. शी to sleep, णिनि aff.
शार: शार r. 10th cl. (शारयति-ते) 	 1. To be weak. 	 2. To weaken.

शार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Variegated, (in colour.) 	 2. Yellow. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. A piece or man at chess, backgammon, &c. 	 3. Hur-ting, injuring. 	 4. A mixture of blue and yellow, a green. 	 5. Spotting, variegating. 	 f. (-री) Kuśa grass.  E. शॄ to injure, घञ् aff.
शारङ्ग: शारङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Of a variegated colour. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The Chātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 	 2. A deer. 	 3. An elephant. 	 4. A bee. 	 5. A peacock. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) A musical instrument, a stringed instrument played with a bow, a sort of fiddle.  E. शार injured or variegated, गम् to go or get, aff. खच्; more usually, सारङ्ग ।
शारता: शारता f. (-ता) 	 1. Variegated of colour. 	 2. Yellowness.  E. तल added to शार ।
शारद: शारद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) 	 1. Modest, diffident. 	 2. New. 	 3. Produced in the sultry season. 	 4. Autumnal. 	 m. (-दः) 	 1. A year. 	 2. Grain or rice ripening in the sultry season. 	 3. A sort of kidney-bean, yellow Mūng. 	 4. Autumnal sickness. 	 5. Sunshine, (in autumn.) 	 f. (-दा) 1. A name of SARASWATĪ. 	 2. A title of DurGĀ. 	 3. A musical instrument, a sort of lute or guitar. 	 f. (-दी) 	 1. A plant, (Jussieua, repens.) 	 2. A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 	 3. Day of full-moon in the month of Kārtika, (October-November.) 	 n. (-दं) 	 1. The white lotus. 	 2. Corn, grain.  E. शरद् the autumn, अण् aff.
शारदिक: शारदिक n. (-कं) A particular obsequial ceremony, an annual or autumnal Śrāddha. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. Autumnal sickness. 	 2. Heat or sunshine in autumn.  E. शारद autumn, and ठञ् aff.
शारदिन्: शारदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Autumnal.  E. शारद, and इनि aff.
शारदीय: शारदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Autumnal.  E. शारद, and छण् added.
शारि: शारि m. (-रिः) 	 1. A piece or man at chess, draughts Chauper, &c. 	 2. An elephant's housings or armour. 	 3. Fraud, trick. 	 mf. (-रिः-री) A bird: see the next.  E. शॄ to injure, Unādi aff. इञ् or ङीप् ।
शारिका: शारिका f. (-का) 	 1. A bird, the proper or hill Mainā, (Gracula religiosa;) it is also applied to the small bird usually called Mainā in Bengal, (Turdus salica, BUCH.) of which several varieties are distinguished by the Hindus. 	 2. A bow or stick that may be used for playing the Vīṇa or any stringed instrument. 	 3. A man at chess.  E. शॄ to injure, aff. वुन् ।
शारित: शारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated, coloured.  E. शार, and इतच् aff.
शारिफल: शारिफल n. (-लं) A chequered cloth or table for playing draughts, &c. E. शारि a piece, फल fruit; also with कन् added शारिफलक mn. (-कः-कं) ।
शारिवा: शारिवा f. (-वा) A plant: as synonimous with Śhyāmā, (Echites frutes-cens,) but more usually considered synonimous with Ananta-mūla (Asclepias pseudosarsa,) the broad-leaved variety, the root of which has been used as a substitute for Sarsaparilla, &c.  E. शारि injuring, from शॄ with इञ् aff., and वन् added.
शारिशृङ्खला: शारिशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A sort of die or dice, used for playing with.  E. शारि a man or piece, and शृङ्खला a chain.
शारीर: शारीर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Corporeal, bodily, belonging to or produced from the body. 	 2. Spiritual in connection with the body, incorpo-rate. 	 3. A bull. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. The soul or spirit whilst incorporate. 	 2. A drug. 	 3. Excrement, excretion. 	 m. (-रः) Personal chastisement, corporeal punishment.  E. शरीर the body, and अण् aff.
शारीरक: शारीरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Corporeal, relating to what is corporeal. 2. Incorporate.  E. कन् added to the last.
शारीरिक: शारीरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the body, corporeal. 	 2. Contained in the body, incorporate.  E. शरीर, ठक् aff.
शारुक: शारुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, noxious, injurious.  E. शॄ to hurt, उकञ् aff.
शार्क: शार्क m. (-र्कः) Clayed or candied sugar.  E. शॄ to injure, aff. क.
शार्कक: शार्कक m. (-कः) 	 1. The broth of milk, syllabub, cream. 	 2. A ball of meat, &c. 	 3. Clayed or candied sugar.  E. कन् added to the last.
शार्कर: शार्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Stony, gravelly. 	 2. Sugary. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The froth or skim of milk. 	 2. Cream. 	 3. A gravelly place.  E. शर्करा sugar, gravel, &c., aff. अण्.
शार्करक: शार्करक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Gravelly, stony, &c.  E. शार्कर the same, and कक् added; also from शर्कर with ठक् aff. शार्करिक.
शार्करीय: शार्करीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Stony, gravelly, &c.  E. शर्करा gravel, &c., and छ attributive aff.
शार्ङ्ग: शार्ङ्ग mfn. (-र्ङ्गः-र्ङ्गी-र्ङ्गं) 	 1. Horny, made of horn, &c. 	 2. Holding a bow. 	 n. (-र्ङ्गं) 	 1. A bow in general. 	 2. The bow of VISHṆU.  E. शृङ्ग a horn, अण् aff.
शार्ङ्गिन्: शार्ङ्गिन् m. (-र्ङ्गी) 	 1. A bowyer, an archer. 	 2. VISHṆU.  E. शार्ङ्ग a bow, इनि poss. aff.
शार्दूल: शार्दूल m. (-लः) 	 1. A tiger. 	 2. Another animal. 	 3. A Rākshasa. 	 4. A sort of bird. 	 5. (In composition,) Pre-eminent, excellent. 	 6. A form of metre, a variety of the class Dhritī, or stanza of four lines of 18 syllables each; also of the class Atidhritī, in which there are 19 syllables in the line.  E. शॄ to injure, दूलच् aff.
शार्दूलललित: शार्दूलललित m. (-तः) A species of the Dhritī metre, of 4 lines of 18 syllables each.
शार्दूलवाहन: शार्दूलवाहन m. (-नः) A Jaina teacher.  E. शार्दूल a tiger, and वाहन a vehicle.
शार्दूलविक्रीडित: शार्दूलविक्रीडित m. (-तः) A form of metre, a variety of the class Atidhritī, or stanza of 4 lines of 19 syllables each.
शार्वर: शार्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 	 1. Murderous, mischievous. 	 2. Nocturnal. 	 n. (-रं) Darkness, gloom. 	 f. (-री) Night.  E. शर्वरी night, अण् aff.
शाल्: शाल्(ऋ)शाऌ r. 1st cl. (शालते) 	 1. To flatter, to praise. 	 2. To boast. 	 3. To tell. 	 4. To be endowed with.
शाल: शाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A kind of fish, (Ophiocephalus wrahl, HAM.) 	 2. The celebrated sovereign SĀLIVĀHANA. 	 3. The name of a river. 	 4. The name of a tree. 	 5. A tree in general. 	 6. An enclosure, a fence. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A house. 	 2. A hall. 	 3. A large branch of a tree. E. शल् to go, घञ् aff.; or शाल् to praise, aff. अच्; in several of the meanings it is also written साल ।
शालग्राम: शालग्राम m. (-मः) A particular sacred stone typical of VISHṆU.
शालङ्कायन: शालङ्कायन m. (-नः) 	 1. The name of a saint. 	 2. ŚIVA'S attendant NANDĪ.
शालङ्कायनजीवसू: शालङ्कायनजीवसू f. (-सूः) The mother of VYĀSA.
शा: शा(सा)लज m. (-जः) 	 1. A kind of fish, the Śāl or Sol, (Ophiocephalus wrahl HAM.) 	 2. Exudation of the Śāla-tree. “धुना ।”
शालनिर्यास: शालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) Resin, the resinous exudation of the Śāl or Sho-rea robusta.  E. शाल the Śāl tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.
शालनिर्य्यास: शालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) Resin, the resinous exudation of the Śāl or Sho-rea robusta.  E. शाल the Śāl tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.
शालपर्णी: शालपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)  E. शाल the Śāl, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीष्, having similar leaves; also सालपर्णी ।
शालभञ्जिका: शालभञ्जिका f. (-का) 	 1. A doll, a puppet. 	 2. A whore, a harlot.  E. कन् added to the following.
शालभञ्जी: शालभञ्जी f. (-ञ्जी) A doll, a puppet.  E. शाल Śāl wood, भञ्ज् to rub, (to plane, &c., in order to make dolls,) affs. अच् and ङीष्; also with कन् added शालभञ्जिका ।
शालवेष्ट: शालवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Resin, the resin of the Śāl tree, used as incense, &c. E. शाल the Śāl tree, and वेष्ट exudation.
शालसार: शालसार m. (-रः) 	 1. A tree. 	 2. Asafœtida; also सालसार ।
शालाकिन्: शालाकिन् m. (-की) 	 1. A surgeon. 	 2. A barber. 	 3. A spearman, &c. E. शलाका a probe, a dart, &c., अण् aff. of reference, and इनि poss. aff. added.
शालाङ्की: शालाङ्की m. (-ङ्की) A doll, a puppet.  E. शाला a hall, अकि to go, affs. अच् and ङीष् ।
शालाजिर: शालाजिर mn. (-रः-रं) A hollow earthen cup or saucer.  E. शाला a house, जॄ to become old, अच् aff.
शालाञ्चि: शालाञ्चि f. (-ञ्चिः) A creeping plant, the leaves of which are used as a vegetable, (Achyranthes triandra.)  E. शाला a house, अञ्च् to go, aff. इन् ।
शालानी: शालानी f. (-नी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)  E. शाल the ŚĀL tree, आङ् before नी to get, (to resemble in the leaf,) aff. क्विप् ।
शालामृग: शालामृग m. (-गः) A jackal.  E. शाला a house, and मृग a deer.
शालार: शालार n. (-रं) 	 1. A ladder, a flight of stairs or steps. 	 2. A bird-cage. 	 3. The claw of an elephant.  E. शाला a house, ऋ to go, aff. अच् ।
शालावृक: शालावृक m. (-कः) 	 1. A monkey. 	 2. A dog. 	 3. A jackal. 	 4. A deer. 	 5. A cat. 	 6. A wolf.  E. शाला a house, वृक a wolf.
शालि: शालि n. (-लि) 	 1. Rice in general, but especially in two classes; one like white rice growing in deep water, and the other a red sort, requiring only a moist soil; there are a great many varieties of this grain. 	 3. The civet or pole cat.  E. शाड् to float or swim, aff. इन्, and ड changed to ल ।
शालिक: शालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to a hall, to the ŚĀL tree, &c. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A weaver. 	 2. A village of artificers. 	 3. A toll, a tax. f. (-का) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.)  E. शाल the ŚĀL tree, कन् fem. form, aff. of comparison; or शाला a hall, ठक् aff.
शालिञ्च: शालिञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A creeper, the leaf of which is used as a vegetable, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.)
शालिता: शालिता f. (-ता) 	 1. Possessing, having. 	 2. Confidence in, relying upon. E. शालिन् and तल् aff.; with त्व, शालित्वं ।
शालिन्: शालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 	 1. Belonging to a house, domestic, &c. 2. A mistress of the house. 	 3. Name of a metre. 	 4. Possessing, having. 	 5. Shining or resplendent with, (in the latter two senses when at the end of a compound.)  E. शाल a house, and इनि aff.; in the fourth form it is the same as शील; the इ being chang-ed to आ when used in composition.
शालिपिष्ट: शालिपिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Crystal.  E. शालि rice, and पिष्ट ground.
शालिवाहन: शालिवाहन m. (-नः) A sovereign of India, whose capital was Pratish-thāna in the Dakshin, and institutor of the era now called Śaka, beginning 76 or 78 years after CHRIST.  E. शालि from शाल the ŚĀL tree, or a proper name, that of a Yaksha transformed to a lion, on which the prince rode when an infant, and वाहन vehicle.
शालिहोत्र: शालिहोत्र m. (-त्रः) 	 1. A horse. 	 2. Name of a writer on veterinary science.  E. शालि rice, corn, and होत्र an oblation; also with इनि added शालिहोत्रिन् m. (-त्री) ।
शालीन: शालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Ashamed, bashful. 	 2. Like, resembling. 	 m. (-नः) An opulent house-holder, one who devotes his attention to worldly affairs.  E. शाला a house, ख aff, (fit or worthy to enter it.)
शालीनत्व: शालीनत्व n. (-त्वं) Modesty.  E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, शालीनता ।
शालीनत्वविवर्ज्जित: शालीनत्वविवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Immodest.  E. शालीनत्व, विवर्ज्जित devoid of.
शालु: शालु m. (-लुः) 	 1. An astringent substance. 	 2. A sort of perfume, com-monly called Chor. 	 3. A frog. 	 n. (-लु) The root of the water-lily. E. शॄ to hurt, उ aff., and र changed to ल; or शाल्-उण् ।
शालुक: शालुक n. (-कं) 	 1. Nutmeg. 	 2. The root of a lotus: see the next.
शालूक: शालूक n. (-कं) The esculent root of the different kinds of Nymphæa or water-lily.  E. शल् to go, to shake, Unādi aff. ऊकञ्; also with a short vowel शालुक ।
शालूर: शालूर m. (-रः) A frog.  E. शल् to go, ऊरच् aff. and the radical vowel made long; also शालुर ।
शालेय: शालेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for rice, (a field, &c.) 	 m. (-यः) A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.)  E. शालि rice, and ढक् aff.
शालोत्तरीय: शालोत्तरीय m. (-यः) A name of PĀṆINI, the inspired grammarian. E. शाला a house, the house of his preceptor, उत्तरीय latter, last; having been expelled for stupidity, and acquiring his subse-quent science by his worship of ŚIVA; according to others, he is supposed to be a native of SĀLOTTARA. The word is sometimes spelt शालातुरीय ।
शाल्मल: शाल्मल m. (-लः) 	 1. The silk-cotton tree. 	 2. One of the Dwipas or divi-sions of the continent. 	 3. The gum of the silk-cotton tree. E. See the next.
शाल्मलि: शाल्मलि mf. (-लिः-ली) 	 1. The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 2. One of the seven Dwipas, or islands or great divisions of the known continent; denominated from the tree first mentioned, said to grow there: it is surrounded by the sea of Ghee or clarified butter.  E. शल् to go, causal form, क्विप् aff., शाल् exuding, emitting, मल् to hold, aff. इन् and ङीष् optionally added; also with अच् aff. शाल्मल, and with the first vowel short, शल्मलि, &c.
शाल्मलिन्: शाल्मलिन् m. (-ली) GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VISHṆU. 	 f. (-लिनी) The silk-cotton tree.
शाल्मलीवेष्ट: शाल्मलीवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The gum of the silk-cotton tree.  E. शाल्मली the tree. and वेष्ट exudation; also with कन् added शाल्मलीवेष्टक ।
शाल्व: शाल्व m. Plu. (-ल्वाः) The inhabitants of one of the central divisions of India.  E. शाल्-व ।
शाव: शाव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 	 1. Tawny, (of that colour.) 	 2. Relating to the purification of defilement from the contact or consanguinity of a corpse, &c. 	 3. Relating to a dead body. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. Tawny, (the colour.) 	 2. The young of any animal: see the next.  E. शव a dead body, and अण् aff.; or शव् to go, aff. घञ् ।
शावक: शावक m. (-कः) The young of any animal.  E. शाव, and कन् added.
शावर: शावर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Low, vile. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. Fault, offence. 	 2. Sin, wicked-ness. 	 3. The Lodh-tree, (Symplocos racemosus.) 	 f. (-री) 	 1. Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) 	 2. A sort of Prākrit, that spoken by barbarians.  E. शवर a man of low or degraded caste, and अण् aff.
शावरभेदाख्य: शावरभेदाख्य n. (-ख्यं) Copper.  E. शावर relating to a low race, भेद class, and आख्य appellation.
शावाशौच: शावाशौच n. (-चं) Impurity from the demise of a relation.  E. शाव, and अशौच impurity.
शाश्वत: शाश्वत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Eternal, perpetual. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. A name of VYĀSA 2. ŚIVA. 	 3. The sun. 	 n. (-तं) Heaven, ether. 	 f. (-ती) The earth.  E. शश्वत् perpetually, अण् aff.
शाष्कुल: शाष्कुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Eating flesh or fish.  E. शुष्कुली flesh, अण् aff., form irr.: see शौष्कुल ।
शाष्कुलिक: शाष्कुलिक n. (-क) A multitude of pies.  E. शष्कुली a sort of pie, ठक् aff.
शास्: शास्(उ)शासु r. 2nd cl. (शास्ति) 	 1. To instruct, to inform. 	 2. To order, to direct, to enact. 	 3. To rule, to govern. 	 4. To correct, to punish. 5. To advise. (शास्ते) 	 1. To wish or desire: with आङ् prefixed, r. 1st cl. (आशासते) r. 2nd cl. (आशास्ते) To wish well to, to bless.
शासन: शासन n. (-नं) 	 1. An order, an edict, a command. 	 2. A royal grant of land or of privileges, a charter, &c. usually inscribed on stone or copper. 	 3. A writing, a deed, a written contract or agreement. 	 4. A Shāstra or scripture. 	 5. Devotion, or devotional tranquillity, the government of the passions. 	 6. Governing, ruling, government. E. शास् to order, to direct, aff. ल्युट् ।
शासनपत्र: शासनपत्र n. (-त्रं) A plate of copper, a stone or sheet of paper, &c., on which an edict or grant is inscribed.  E. शासन, and पत्र a leaf.
शासनहर: शासनहर m. (-रः) A royal messenger, one bearing an edict or grant. E. शासन an edict, and हर who takes.
शासनीय: शासनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be governed or directed.  E. शास् to rule, अनीयर् aff; also शासितव्य and शास्य ।
शासित: शासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Governed, ruled.  E. शास् to rule, aff. क्त ।
शासितृ: शासितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Ordering, commanding, a governor or com-mander.  E. शास् to order, तृच् aff. with इट् augment.
शास्ति: शास्ति f. (-स्तिः) 	 1. A command, an order. 	 2. Governing, ruling, order-ing. 	 3. A sceptre. 	 4. Correctre, punishment.  E. शास् to govern, aff. क्तिन् or ति Uṇādi aff.
शास्तृ: शास्तृ mfn. (-स्ता-स्त्री-स्तृ) 	 1. A ruler, one who rules or governs. 	 2. A teacher, teaching, instructing. 	 m. (-स्ता) A Buddha or Jina, or the deified teacher of one or both those sects.  E. शास् to govern, &c. aff. तृच्, and the augment omitted.
शास्त्र: शास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 	 1. An order or command. 	 2. Scripture, science, insti-tutes of religion, law or letters, especially considered as of divine origin or authority: when used singly, it implies works of literature or science in general, and it is therefore customarily connected with some other word to limit its application, as the Vedānta Śhās-tras, or treatises of philosophical theology; the Dharma-Śhāstras, books of law, &c.; it is also applied to less important branches of knowledge, as the Kāvya-Śhāstras, or poetical works; Shilpa-Śhāstras, works on the mechanical arts; and Kāma-Śhāstras, or erotic compositions; in the singular number it is also used com-prehensively to signify the body of all that has been written on the subject, as Dharma-Śhāstras, the institutes or code of law; Kāvya-Śhāstra, poetry; Alankāra-Śhāstra, rhetoric, &c. 	 3. A book in general.  E. शास् to govern or teach, aff. ष्ट्रन् ।
शास्त्रकृत्: शास्त्रकृत् m. (-कृत्) 	 1. A Rishi, a holy personage of divine character. 	 2. An author in general.  E. शास्त्र a Śhāstra or scripture, &c., and कृत् the author; the principal compositions in Hindu religion, law, and literature, being attributed to sanctified and superhuman personages.
शास्त्रगण्ड: शास्त्रगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A general and superficial scholar.
शास्त्रचक्षुस्: शास्त्रचक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) Grammar.  E. शास्त्र science, and चक्षुस् the eye.
शास्त्रज्ञ: शास्त्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Acquainted with the Śhāstras, skilled in the knowledge of law and religion especially.  E. शास्त्र a sacred work and ज्ञ who knows.
शास्त्रज्ञता: शास्त्रज्ञता f. (-ता) Knowledge of the Śhāstras.  E. शास्त्रज्ञ and तल् aff.; also त्व with शास्त्रज्ञत्वं ।
शास्त्रज्ञान: शास्त्रज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge derived from the study of sacred works. E. शास्त्र, and ज्ञान knowledge.
शास्त्रतत्त्व: शास्त्रतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The truth or true knowledge taught in sacred works. E. शास्त्र and तत्त्व truth.
शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञ: शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Understanding the works of sacred science. m. (-ज्ञः) An astrologer, an astronomer.  E. शास्त्र sacred or astrono-mical science, तत्त्व the truth, and ज्ञ who knows.
शास्त्रतस्: शास्त्रतस् Ind. After or according to the Śhāstras.  E. शास्त्र, and तसि aff.
शास्त्रदाशन्: शास्त्रदाशन् mfn. (-र्शा-र्शिनी-र्शि) Skilled in sacred science.  E. शास्त्र Śhās-tra, and दशिन् who inspects.
शास्त्रनिन्दा: शास्त्रनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Reviling or denying the authority of sacred works. E. शास्त्र, and निन्दा reviling.
शास्त्रप्रसङ्ग: शास्त्रप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The subject of the Śhāstra. 	 2. Discussing works of sacred literature.  E. शास्त्र, प्रसङ्ग attaching to.
शास्त्रवत्: शास्त्रवत् Ind. Conformably or according to written authority.  E. शास्त्र, वति aff.
शास्त्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having or following sacred institutes, &c. E. शास्त्र, and मतुप् aff.
शास्त्रविद्: शास्त्रविद् mfn. (-विद्) Understanding or conversant with the scrip-tures, skilled in sacred science.  E. शास्त्र a Śhāstra, विद् who knows.
शास्त्रविधान: शास्त्रविधान n. (-नं) Sacred ritual, ceremonial precept.  E. शास्त्र, and विधान direction; also शास्त्रविधि ।
शास्त्रविप्रतिषिद्ध: शास्त्रविप्रतिषिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to law or religion, illegal, forbidden.  E. शास्त्र a Śhāstra, and विप्रतिषिद्ध prohibited.
शास्त्रविप्रतिषेध: शास्त्रविप्रतिषेध n. (-धं) Any act contrary to the legal and religious institutes of the Hindus.  E. शास्त्र an institute, and वि and प्रति contra-indicative prefixes before षिद्ध् to accomplish, aff. घञ् ।
शास्त्रविरुद्ध: शास्त्रविरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to law or religion.  E. शास्त्र and विरुद्ध opposed to.
शास्त्रविरोध: शास्त्रविरोध m. (-धः) 	 1. Opposition or deviation from sacred authority. 2. Contradiction or incompatibility of different systems.  E. शास्त्र, and विरोध contrariety.
शास्त्रशिल्पिन्: शास्त्रशिल्पिन् plu. 	 m. (-नः) The people of Kāshmir.  E. शास्त्र a treatise, and शिल्पिन् an artificer.
शास्त्रसिद्ध: शास्त्रसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Established or proved by sacred institutes or divine works.  E. शास्त्र, and सिद्ध established.
शास्त्राचरण: शास्त्राचरण m. (-णः) 	 1. Versed in the scriptures, well read in the works of sacred science, a Paṇḍit. 	 2. A follower of the Vedas, one whose conduct is regulated by their precepts.  E. शास्त्र a sacred treatise, and आचरण who goes through or studies.
शास्त्रातिक्रम: शास्त्रातिक्रम m. (-मः) Behaving ill or immorally, transgressing, acting contrary to the Śhāstras.  E. शास्त्र and अतिक्रम surpassing.
शास्त्रानुष्ठान: शास्त्रानुष्ठान n. (-नं) Following the Śhāstras, conforming to the law or ritual, &c.  E. शास्त्र, and अनुष्ठान conforming.
शास्त्रानुष्ठित: शास्त्रानुष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Who or what obeys or follows sacred institutes, &c. 	 2. Established or authorised by the Śhāstras. E. शास्त्र, and अनुष्ठित following.
शास्त्रानुसार: शास्त्रानुसार m. (-रः) Conformity to sacred ordinances.  E. शास्त्र, अनुसार following.
शास्त्राभिज्ञ: शास्त्राभिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Learned, versed in the Śhāstras.  E. शास्त्र, and अभिज्ञ who knows.
शास्त्रिन्: शास्त्रिन् m. (-स्त्री) A Paṇḍit, a teacher of holy science, or one skilled in it.  E. शास्त्र as above, and इनि aff.
शास्त्रीय: शास्त्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Scriptural, authorised by or conformable to sacred institutes.  E. शास्त्र, and छ aff.
शास्त्रोक्त: शास्त्रोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said or declared in a work of sacred authority.  E. शास्त्र, and उक्त said.
शास्य: शास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 	 1. To be regulated or ordained, to be enforced, to be provided for by any act of government or judicature. 	 2. To be advised. 	 3. Punishable, deserving punishment.  E. शास् to govern, aff. ण्यत् ।
शि: शि(ञ)शिञ् r. 5th cl. (शिनोति शिनुते) 	 1. To make thin or small. 	 2. To whet, to sharpen. 	 3. To excite. 	 4. To be attentive.
शि m. (-शिः) 	 1. ŚIVA. 	 2. Auspiciousness, good fortune. 	 3. Peace, com-posure, calm.  E. शि to whet, or शो to destroy, aff. कि ।
शिंशपा: शिंशपा f. (-पा) 	 1. A tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) 	 2. The Asoka tree.  E. शीघ्र quick, or शीर्ष the head or top; पा to cherish, or पत् to fall, &c., aff. क or ड, deriv. irr.
शिक्कु: शिक्कु mfn. (-क्कुः-क्कुः-क्कु) Idle, lazy, following no business or profession.
शिक्थ: शिक्थ n. (-क्थं) Bee's wax; also शिक्थकं and सिक्थकं ।
शिक्य: शिक्य nf. (-क्यं-क्या) 	 1. The string or loop suspended from either end of a pole or yoke to receive the burthen. 	 2. The burthen so carried. 	 3. The strings of a balance.  E. श्रंस् to fall, Unādi aff. यत्; शि substi-tuted for the root, and कुट् augment.
शिक्याधार: शिक्याधार m. (-रः) The hook or eye at each end of a pole or beam, to which the strings of a yoke or balance are fastened.  E. शिक्या as above, and आधार receptacle.
शिक्यित: शिक्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended or carried in a sort of loop.  E. शिक्य a loop, and इतच् aff.
शिक्ष्: शिक्ष् r. 1st cl. (शिक्षते) To learn, to acquire science.
शिक्षक: शिक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A learner, a teacher.  E. शिक्ष् to learn, ण्वुल् aff.
शिक्षणीय: शिक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taught or learnt.  E. शिक्ष् to learn, अनीयर् aff.
शिक्षा: शिक्षा f. (-क्षा) 	 1. One of the six Vedāngas or sciences attached to the Vedas: the proper pronunciation of the vocal sounds which occur in them, as explained by PĀṆINI. 	 2. A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 	 3. Learning, study, the acquisition of knowledge. 	 4. Modesty, humility.  E. शिक्ष् to learn, affs. अङ् and टाप् ।
शिक्षाकर: शिक्षाकर m. (-रः) 	 1. VYĀSA. 	 2. An instructor.  E. शिक्षा the science of pronunciation, and कर making.
शिक्षानर: शिक्षानर m. (-रः) An epithet of INDRA.
शिक्षाशक्ति: शिक्षाशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Dexterity, skill.  E. शिक्षा discipline, and शक्ति power.
शिक्षित: शिक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Skilful, clever, conversant. 	 2. Modest, diffident. 	 3. Disciplined, exercised. 	 4. Tame, trained, (as an animal.) 	 5. Docile. 	 6. Studied, learned.  E. शिक्षा studying, इतच् aff.; or शिक्ष् to study, aff. क्त ।
शिक्षितव्य: शिक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taught or learnt.  E. शिक्ष् to learn, and तव्य aff.
शिक्षिताक्षर: शिक्षिताक्षर m. (-रः) A pupil, a scholar.  E. शिक्षित study, (by whom,) and अक्षर a letter.
शिक्ष्य: शिक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 	 1. To be taught, teachable.  E. शिक्ष् to learn, यत् aff.
शिख्: शिख्(इ) r. 1st cl. (शिङ्खति) To go, to move or approach.
शिखण्ड: शिखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. The tail of a peacock. 	 2. Locks of hair left on the crown or the sides of the head, at the period of tonsure in chil-dren: see the next.  E. शिखिन् a peacock or any crested object, अम् to be or belong to, ड aff. and the form irr.
शिखण्डक: शिखण्डक m. (-कः) 	 1. Locks of hair left at the time of tonsure; three or five locks left in children in general, or especially those of the military class, in which latter case, the hair is left in a semicir-cular patch on each side of the head, covering rather more than the temporal bones, and following much the same outline: see काकपक्ष. 	 2. The crest or lock of hair left on the crown of the head. 3. A peacock's tail.  E. शिखा a crest, अण्ड an egg, and कन् pleonasm, or aff. of comparison; also शिखाण्डक and शिखण्ड ।
शिखण्डिक: शिखण्डिक m. (-कः) A cock. 	 f. (-का) A lock of hair on the crown of the head.  E. शिखण्ड a crest, &c. aff. ठक् or कन् in the fem. form.
शिखण्डिन्: शिखण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) 	 1. A peacock. 	 2. A peacock's tail. 	 3. A cock. 	 4. An arrow. 	 5. A Rishi, either of the seven represented by the stars of the greater bear: see चित्रशिखण्डिन् । 6. The son of DRUPADA, by metamor-phosis: see below. 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A kind of jasmine, (J. auriculatum.) 	 2. A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) 	 3. The daughter of DRUPADA, after-wards changed to a male. 	 4. A peahen.  E. शिखण्ड a crest, इनि poss. aff.
शिखर: शिखर mn. (-रः-रं) 	 1. The peak or summit of a mountain. 	 2. The top of a tree. 	 3. Point, end, top in general. 	 4. Horripilation. 	 5. The armpit. 	 6. A piece of a ruby or a gem, described as of the colour of the ripe pomegranate seed or a bright red. 	 7. The bud of the Arabian jasmine. 	 8. The edge or point of a sword. 	 f. (-रा) A plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings were made, (Sanse-viera zeylanica.)  E. शिखा a crest, and रच् poss. aff., and the vowel made short.
शिखरवासिनी: शिखरवासिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ.  E. शिखर the peak, (of the Himālaya,) and वासिनी abiding.
शिखरिन्: शिखरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Crested, peaked, pointed. 	 m. (-री) 	 1. A mountain. 	 2. A tree. 	 3. A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 	 4. A strong-hold, a hill-fort. 	 5. The lapwing. 	 f. (-रिणी) 	 1. A form of metre, a species of the class Atyashtī metre or verse of four lines of 17 syllables each. 	 2. A dish of curds and sugar with spices. 	 3. An excellent woman. 	 4. Arabian jasmine. 	 5. A line of hair extending across the navel.  E. शिखर a point or peak, and इनि aff.
शिखलोहित: शिखलोहित m. (-तः) A plant, commonly Kukurmurā.
शिखा: शिखा f. (-खा) 	 1. Point, top in general. 	 2. A crest. 	 3. A peacock's crest. 4. A lock of hair on the crown of the head. 	 5. Flame. 	 6. A radi-cating branch. 	 7. Any branch. 	 8. A plant, commonly Lāngaliyā. 9. Chief, principal. 	 10. Fever, proceeding from libidinous excite-ment or love. 	 11. A ray of light. 	 12. The end of a garment. 	 13. A fibrous root. 	 14. The forepart of the foot.  E. शीङ् to sleep, Unādi aff. ख, and the vowel made short.
शिखाण्डक: शिखाण्डक m. (-कः) Hair left on each side of the head: see शिखण्डक ।
शिखातरु: शिखातरु m. (-रुः) A candle-stick or lamp-stand.  E. शिखा flame, तरु a tree.
शिखाधर: शिखाधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Crested, pointed. 	 2. Having a top-knot. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A peacock. 	 2. A jaina deified saint.  E. शिखा a crest, and धर who has.
शिखाधार: शिखाधार m. (-रः) A peacock.  E. शिखा a crest, and धार who has.
शिखामूल: शिखामूल n. (-लं) A carrot, a turnip, or any root with a tuft of leaves growing from it.  E. शिखा a crest, and मूल a root.
शिखालु: शिखालु m. (-लुः) A peacock's crest.  E. शिखा, आलुच् aff.
शिखावत्: शिखावत् m. (-वान्) 	 1. A name of AGNI or fire. 	 2. The personified descending node. 	 3. A lamp. 	 f. (-वती) A plant, (Sansevier a zeylanica.)  E. शिखा a crest, and मतुप् poss. aff.
शिखावर: शिखावर m. (-रः) The jack-fruit tree (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
शिखावल: शिखावल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Crested, pointed. 	 m. (-लः) A peacock. 	 f. (-ला) A flower, (Celosia cristata.)  E. शिखा a crest, and वलच् aff.
शिखावृक्ष: शिखावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The stand of a lamp.  E. शिखा a flame, and वृक्ष a tree.
शिखावृद्धि: शिखावृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Usurious interest payable daily.  E. शिखा a tuft of hair, and वृद्धि interest; growing constantly.
शिखिग्रीव: शिखिग्रीव n. (-वं) Blue vitriol.  E. शिखि for शिखिन् a peacock, ग्रीवा the neck, अच् added; being of the same colour.
शिखिध्वज: शिखिध्वज m. (-जः) 	 1. Smoke. 	 2. The deity KĀRTIKEYA.  E. शिखि a peacock or fire, and ध्वज an emblem.
शिखिन्: शिखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) 	 1. Crested. 	 2. Having a lock of hair on the top of the head. 	 3. Proud. 	 m. (-खी) 	 1. Fire. 	 2. A peacock. 	 3. A bull. 	 4. An arrow. 	 5. A tree. 	 6. A cock. 	 7. KETU, the personified descending node. 	 8. A horse. 	 9. A mountain. 	 10. A Brāhman. 	 11. A lamp. 	 12. A religious mendicant.  E. शिखा a crest, &c., इनि aff.
शिखिपुच्छ: शिखिपुच्छ n. (-च्छं) A peacock's tail.  E. शिखि a peacock, and पुच्छ a tail.
शिखिमण्डल: शिखिमण्डल m. (-लः) A tree, (Tapia cratæva.)  E. शिखि a peacock, and मण्डल district.
शिखिवर्द्धक: शिखिवर्द्धक m. (-कः) A pumpkin-gourd.  E. शिखि a peacock, and वर्द्धक increasing.
शिखिवाहन: शिखिवाहन m. (-नः) KĀRTIKEYA.  E. शिखि a peacock, and वाहन a vehi-cle, the deity being mounted on this bird.

शिलातल: शिलातल n. (-लं) The surface of a rock or stone.  E. शिला, तल below.
शिलात्मज: शिलात्मज n. (-जं) Iron.  E. शिला a stone, आत्मन् self, and ज born.
शिलात्मिका: शिलात्मिका f. (-का) A crucible.  E. शिला a stone, आत्मन् substance, कन् aff., fem. form.
शिलादद्रु: शिलादद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Bitumen.  E. शिला a stone, and दद्रु herpes.
शिलाधातु: शिलाधातु m. (-तुः) 	 1. Chalk. 	 2. Red chalk. 	 3. A white fossile subs-tance; an aluminous earth of a white colour, and thence consider-ed to be a sort of chalk.  E. शिला a stone or rock, and धातु a mineral.
शिलापट्ट: शिलापट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A flat stone for grinding condiments, &c.  E. शिला a stone, and पट्ट a flat surface.
शिलापुत्त्र: शिलापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A muller or roller for grinding condiments, &c. on a flat stone.  E. शिला a flat stone, and पुत्त्र child; also शिलापुत्त्रक ।
शिलापुष्प: शिलापुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Storax or Benzoin.  E. शिला a rock, पुष्प flower.
शिलाफलक: शिलाफलक n. (-कं) A layer or table of rock or stone.  E. शिला, फलक a plank.
शिलाभव: शिलाभव n. (-वं) Storax or Benzion.  E. शिला a rock, and भव born.
शिलाभेद: शिलाभेद m. (-दः) 	 1. A plant, (Plectranthes scutellaroides.) 	 2. A stone-cutter's chisel.  E. शिला a stone, and भेद what breaks.
शिलामय: शिलामय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Made of stone.  E. शिला, मयट् aff.
शिलारस: शिलारस m. (-सः) Incense, Benjamin or Olibanum.  E. शिला a stone, रस, juice.
शिलाबल्का: शिलाबल्का f. (-ल्का) A medicinal substance said to be of cooling and lithonthriptic properties, commonly termed Silabāk; a sort of lichen or moss.  E. शिला a stone or rock, and वल्क bark; also termed शिलावल्कल, शिलात्वच् ।
शिलावृष्टि: शिलावृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Hail.  E. शिला, and वृष्टि rain.
शिलाव्याधि: शिलाव्याधि m. (-धिः) Bitumen.  E. शिला a rock or stone, व्याधि sickness.
शिलासन: शिलासन n. (-नं) 	 1. Benzoin or Storax. 	 2. A stone bench or seat.  E. शिला a stone or rock, and असन abiding or आसन a seat.
शिलासार: शिलासार n. (-रं) Iron.  E. शिला a stone, and सार essence.
शिलि: शिलि f. (-लिः-ली) 	 1. The lower timber of a door. 	 2. A female frog. 3. An arrow. 	 4. A kind of earth-worm. 	 m. (-लिः) The Bhurja-patra or birch-tree.  E. शिल् to glean, कि aff.: see शिल, शिला, &c.
शिलिन्द: शिलिन्द m. (-न्दः) A kind of fish.
शिलीन्ध्र: शिलीन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) 	 1. The flower of the plantain tree. 	 2. Hail. 	 3. A mushroom. 	 m. (-न्ध्रः) 	 1. A sort of tree. 	 2. A kind of fish; also चित्रफलक. 	 f. (-न्ध्री) 	 1. Earth, clay. 	 2. A small earth-worm. 	 3. A sort of bird.
शिलीन्ध्रक: शिलीन्ध्रक n. (-कं) A mushroom, one growing out of cowdung, a fungus.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
शिलीपद: शिलीपद m. (-दः) Enlarged or Tropical leg; also श्लीपद ।
शिलीमुख: शिलीमुख m. (-खः) 	 1. A bee. 	 2. An arrow. 	 3. A fool, a block-head. 	 4. War.  E. शिली a dart, (a sting,) and मुख the face.
शिलेय: शिलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Like a stone or rock, as hard, &c. 	 n. (-यं) Storax.  E. शिला a rock; ढक् aff. and the vowel unchanged.
शिलोच्चय: शिलोच्चय m. (-यः) 	 1. A mountain. 	 2. A high mountain.  E. शिला a stone or rock, उत् up, चि to collect, अच् aff.
शिलोञ्छ: शिलोञ्छ m. (-ञ्छः) 	 1. Following more than one occupation. 	 2. Gleaning. E. शिला gleaning, उञ्छ् to gather or glean, aff. अच्; gleaning a subsistence.
शिलोञ्छवृत्ति: शिलोञ्छवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Livelihood gained by gleaning. 	 2. Extraordinary occupation.  E. शिलोञ्छ, and वृत्ति subsistence.
शिलोत्थ: शिलोत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Growing from or upon rock or stone. 	 n. (-त्थं) Benzoin or Storax.  E. शिला a stone, and उत्थ what grows.
शिलोद्भव: शिलोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced from stone or rock. 	 n. (-वं) 	 1. A superior sort of Sandal-wood, either the white or brass-coloured sort. 	 2. Storax or Benzoin.  E. शिला a stone or rock, उद्भव produced.
शिलौकस्: शिलौकस् m. (-काः) GARUḌA.  E. शिला a rock, and ओकस् abode.
शिल्प: शिल्प n. (-ल्पं) 	 1. An art, any manual or mechanical art, (sixty-four such arts are enumerated.) 	 2. Skill, ingenuity. 	 3. A ceremonial act. 	 4. A sort of spoon or ladle, used at sacrifices to throw the Ghee or butter into the fire.  E. शिल् to be clever or skilled, पक् Unādi aff., and the vowel made short.
शिल्पक: शिल्पक n. (-कं) A sort of drama: one exhibiting magical and mystical rites,  E. शिल्प manual art, and कन् aff.; also read शिल्पिकं ।
शिल्पकर्मन्: शिल्पकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Manual labour, handicraft.  E. शिल्प, and कर्म्मन् act; also शिल्पक्रिया, &c.
शिल्पकर्म्मन्: शिल्पकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Manual labour, handicraft.  E. शिल्प, and कर्म्मन् act; also शिल्पक्रिया, &c.
शिल्पकार: शिल्पकार m. (-रः) An artisan, a mechanic.  E. शिल्प a handicraft, कार who makes.
शिल्पविद्या: शिल्पविद्या f. (-द्या) Art, mechanical or manual skill.  E. शिल्प, and विद्या knowledge.
शिल्पशाल: शिल्पशाल nf. (-लं-ला) A work-shop, a manufactory.  E. शिल्प art, and शाला a hall.
शिल्पिक: शिल्पिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Manual, mechanic. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. Handicraft. 	 2. A sort of drama: see शिल्पक.  E. शिल्प, and ठक् aff.
शिल्पिन्: शिल्पिन् mfn. (-ल्पी-ल्पिनी-ल्पि) 	 1. An artist, an artificer or artisan. 	 2. Belonging or relating to a mechanical profession or art. 	 f. (-ल्पि नी) A drug or herb, a kind of grass said to the known by the name of Lahānasipi, and described as sweet and cooling, and bearing seeds of tonic, and restorative properties; also शिल्पिका, &c.  E. शिल्प art, and इनि aff.
शिल्पिशाल: शिल्पिशाल nf. (-लं-ला) A work-shop, a manufactory.  E. शिल्पि an artisan, and शाला a hall.
शिल्पिशास्त्र: शिल्पिशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A treatise or set of treatises on works of art. E. शिल्पि an artist, and शास्त्र book.
शिव: शिव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Prosperous, happy. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. The deity ŚIVA, the most formidable of the Hindu triad, the destroyer of creation: the adoration of which he is the object, is of a more gloomy nature in general than that of the rest, and he is the particular god of the Tāntrikas or followers of the books called Tantras. 	 2. Final emancipation from existence, eternal happiness. 	 3. A pillar or post to which cattle are tied. 	 4. An auspicious planetary conjunc-tion. 	 5. Scripture, the Vedas. 	 6. A drug, commonly Elabālukā. 7. A perfume, Puṇḍarīya. 	 8. Bdellium. 	 9. One of the astronomi-cal periods termed Yogas. 	 10. Quicksilver. 	 11. The penis. 	 12. The phallic emblem of ŚIVA. 	 13. A god. 	 n. (-वं) 	 1. Happiness, pleasure. 2. Auspiciousness, well being. 	 3. Water. 	 4. Sea or fossile salt. 	 5. Borax. 	 6. Rock-salt. 	 f. (-वा) 	 1. The goddess DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. 	 2. The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.) 	 3. Yellow myro-balan, (Terminalia chebula.) 	 4. Emblic myrobalan. 	 5. A jackal. 6. The mother of the twenty-second Jina. 	 7. Final emancipation. 8. A kind of yellow pigment. 	 9. The Durbā-grass.  E. शी to sleep Unādi aff. वन्, on or in whom or which, the universe reposes.
शिवक: शिवक m. (-कः) 	 1. A post to which cows or calves are tied. 	 2. A post for cattle to rub against.  E. शिव the same, कन् aff.
शिवकर: शिवकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, auspicious, making happy. 	 m. (-रः) A Jina of the last age.  E. शिव good fortune, and कर who makes.
शिवकीर्तन: शिवकीर्त्तन m. (-नः) 	 1. An attendant on ŚIVA. 	 2. KRISHṆA or VISHṆU. n. (-नं) Praising or hymning ŚIVA.  E. शिव ŚIVA, कीर्त्तन celebrating.
शिवकीर्त्तन: शिवकीर्त्तन m. (-नः) 	 1. An attendant on ŚIVA. 	 2. KRISHṆA or VISHṆU. n. (-नं) Praising or hymning ŚIVA.  E. शिव ŚIVA, कीर्त्तन celebrating.
शिवगति: शिवगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 	 1. Happy, prosperous. 	 2. Worshipping ŚIVA. m. (-तिः) One of the Jinas of the past age.  E. शिव auspiciousness. गति going.
शिवघर्मज: शिवघर्म्मज m. (-जः) The planet MARS.  E. शिव ŚIVA, घर्म्म perspiration, and ज born.
शिवघर्म्मज: शिवघर्म्मज m. (-जः) The planet MARS.  E. शिव ŚIVA, घर्म्म perspiration, and ज born.
शिवङ्कर: शिवङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, auspicious, conferring happiness or good fortune.  E. शिव good fortune, कृ to make, aff. खच् ।
शिवचतुर्दशी: शिवचतुर्दशी f. (-शी) A festival held in honour of ŚIVA, on the fourteenth of the dark-half of Māgha.  E. शिव, चतुर्दशी fourteenth.
शिवज्ञ: शिवज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 	 1. Knowing what is good or propitious. 	 2. Worshipping ŚIVA. 	 f. (-ज्ञा) A female devotee of the Saiva sect. E. शिव ŚIVA, and ज्ञा to know, अङ् and टाप् affs.
शिवताति: शिवताति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Propitious, conferring happiness or fortune. E. शिव happiness, तातिल् aff.; also शिवतातिक ।
शिवदत्त: शिवदत्त n. (-त्तं) The discus of VISHṆU.  E. शिव ŚIVA, and दत्त given.
शिवदारु: शिवदारु m. (-रुः) The Devadāru tree, (Pinus Deodar.)
शिवदूतिका: शिवदूतिका f. (-का) One of the Mātris or divine mothers.  E. शिवदूति DURGĀ, and कन् aff.
शिवदूती: शिवदूती f. (-ती) DURGĀ.  E. शिव ŚIVA, and दूती, from दूत a messenger, fem. aff. ङीष् ।
शिवधातु: शिवधातु m. (-तुः) 	 1. The milk stone, opal or chalcedony. 	 2. Quick-silver. E. शिव ŚIVA, धातु a mineral.
शिवपुरी: शिवपुरी f. (-री) The holy city Benares.  E. शिव, and पुरी the city; being sacred to ŚIVA especially.
शिवप्रिय: शिवप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dear to or esteemed by ŚIVA. 	 m. (-यः) 	 1. The Sesbana grandiflora. 	 2. Crystal. 	 f. (-या) The goddess DURGĀ. 	 n. (-यं) The seeds of the Eleocarpus.  E. शिव, and प्रिय beloved.
शिवमल्ली: शिवमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The Sesbana grandiflora.  E. शिव, and मल्ली jasmine.
शिवरस: शिवरस m. (-सः) The water of boiled-rice or pulse three days old, and undergoing spontaneous fermentation.
शिवरात्रि: शिवरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) A celebrated festival held in honour of ŚIVA on the fourteenth of the moon's wane or dark-fortnight in Māgha. E. शिव, and रात्रि night.
शिवलिङ्ग: शिवलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) ŚIVA in the form of a phallus.
शिववल्लभ: शिववल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Loved or esteemed by ŚIVA. 	 m. (-भः) 1. The mango tree. 	 2. Gigantic swallow-wort. 	 f. (-भा) The goddess PĀRVATĪ.  E. शिव ŚIVA, and वल्लभ beloved.
शिववाहन: शिववाहन m. (-नः) A bull.  E. शिव the deity, वाहन vehicle.
शिववीज: शिववीज n. (-जं) Quicksilver.  E. शिव ŚIVA, and वीज semen; its supposed origin.
शिवशेखर: शिवशेखर m. (-रः) 	 1. The Sesbana grandiflora. 	 2. The moon.  E. शिव ŚIVA, and शेखर a crest.
शिवाक्ष: शिवाक्ष n. (-क्षं) The seed of the Eleocarpus.  E. शिव ŚIVA, and अक्ष from अक्षि the eye. “रुद्राक्षे ।”
शिवानी: शिवानी f. (-नी) 	 1. A flower, (Celtis orientalis.) 	 2. A name of DURGĀ. E. शिव the deity, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.
शिवाप्रिय: शिवाप्रिय m. (-यः) A goat.  E. शिवा DURGĀ, and प्रिय beloved by.
शिवाराति: शिवाराति m. (-तिः) A dog.  E. शिवा a jackal, and अराति an enemy.
शिवालय: शिवालय m. (-यः) Red Tulaśi or basil. 	 n. (-यं) 	 1. A cemetery or place where dead bodies are burnt or buried. 	 2. Any temple dedicated to ŚIVA.  E. शिव ŚIVA, and आलय abode.
शिवालु: शिवालु m. (-लुः) A jackal. शिवायालति अल-उन् ।
शिवि: शिवि m. (-विः) 	 1. A beast of prey. 	 2. The Bhurja-patra or birch-tree. 	 3. A king so named.
शिविका: शिविका f. (-का) 	 1. A palanquin, a litter.  E. शिव nominal verb, to give pleasure or ease, aff. ण्वुल् ।
शिविपिष्ट: शिविपिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A name of ŚIVA: see शिपिविष्ट ।
शिविर: शिविर n. (-रं) 	 1. A camp. 	 2. A royal camp or residence. 	 3. A guard or defence for the soldiers. 	 4. A sort of grain.  E. शी to sleep or rest, किरक् Unādi aff. and वुक् augment.
शिवीरथ: शिवीरथ m. (-थः) A palanquin, a litter.  E. शिवी for शिविका the same, रथ a conveyance.
शिशयिषा: शिशयिषा f. (-षा) Drowsiness, sleepiness, wish to sleep.  E. शी to sleep, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् affs.
शिशयिषु: शिशयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Sleepy, drowsy.  E. शी to sleep, desid. v., उ aff.
शिशिर: शिशिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cold, frigid, chilly, freezing. 	 m. (-रः) Frost. 	 mn. (-रः-रं) The cold season, comprising two months from about the middle of January to that of March. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Coolness. 	 2. Dew, hoar-frost. 	 3. The cool season.  E. शश् to go, (the sun, north of the equator,) किरच् Unādi aff. and the radical vowel changed to इ ।
शिशिरकाल: शिशिरकाल n. (-लं) The dewy season: see the last.  E. शिशिर, काल time.
शिशु: शिशु m. (-शुः) 	 1. The young of man or any animal, a child, a calf, &c. 	 2. A pupil, a scholar. 	 3. A boy under eight years of age. 4. A lad or boy not more than sixteen.  E. शो to destroy, Unādi aff. उ, and the root repeated, with इ substituted for the semivowel to which the radical vowel is changed in its inflections.
शिशुक: शिशुक m. (-कः) 	 1. A porpoise. 	 2. Another fish, resembling a porpoise. 3. A child, a young animal. 	 4. A tree.  E. कन् added to the last.
शिशुक्रन्द: शिशुक्रन्द m. (-न्दः) The weeping of an infant or child.  E. शिशु a child, and क्रन्द weeping; also शिशुक्रन्दन n. (-नं) ।
शिशुक्रन्दनीय: शिशुक्रन्दनीय m. (-यः) A book or work treating of infantine or juvenile grievances.  E. शिशुक्रन्द as above, and छ aff. in this sense.
शिशुत्व: शिशुत्व n. (-त्वं) 	 1. Boyhood, pupilage, the period before sixteen. 	 2. Childhood, the period up to eight years of age.  E. शिशु a child, त्व abstract aff.; also with तल् aff. शिशुता ।
शिशुपाल: शिशुपाल m. (-लः) The sovereign of a country in the central part of India or Chedi, opposed to KRISHṆA and slain by him: his death forms the subject of one of the Hindu epic poems, thence named Śiśupāla-Badha, by MĀGHA.  E. शिशु a child, पाल who cherishes.
शिशुपालक: शिशुपालक m. (-कः) 	 1. A king: see the last. 	 2. A plant, (Nauclea cordi-folia.)  E. शिशु child, पाल who or what pleases or cherishes, aff कन् ।
शिशुपालहन्: शिशुपालहन् m. (-हा) KRISHṆA.  E. शिशुपाल the king, हन् destroyer.
शिशुमार: शिशुमार m. (-रः) 	 1. The Gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus gangeticus.) 	 2. The heavenly porpoise, or collection of the stars and planets. 	 3. A name or form of VISHṆU.  E. शिशु child, and मार what kills.
शिशुवाहक: शिशुवाहक m. (-कः) A wild goat.  E. शिशु a child, वह् to bear, aff. ण्वुल् ।
शिशुवाह्यक: शिशुवाह्यक m. (-कः) A wild goat.  E. शिशु a child, वह् to bear, ण्यत् aff., and कन् added.
शिश्न: शिश्न m. (-श्नः) The penis.  E. शश् to move, aff. नक्, form irr.
शिश्विदान: शिश्विदान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Innocent, virtuous. 	 2. Guilty, sinful, wicked. E. श्वित् to be white, (pure or virtuous,) आनच् Unādi aff., त changed to द, and the reduplicate form of the root.
शिष्: शिष् r. 1st cl. (शेषति) To hurt, to injure or kill. r. 1st and 10th cls. (शेषति शेषयति-ते) To leave a residue, not to use the whole. (Usually with वि prefixed.) To excel. (ॡ and with वि prefixed.) विशिषॢ r. 7th cl. (विशिनष्टि) To assign attributes or qualities to, to distinguish, to individualize, to specify.
शिष्ट: शिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Obedient, docile. 	 2. Ordered, commanded, disciplined, trained. 	 3. Chief, principal, eminent, select. 	 4. Left, remaining. 	 5. Wise. 	 m. (-ष्टः) 	 1. A courtier, a counsellor. 	 2. A chief.  E. शास् to order, aff. क्त, form irr.; or शिष् to leave, क्त aff.
शिष्टता: शिष्टता f. (-ता) 	 1. Good behaviour, urbanity, civility. 	 2. Docility. 	 3. The property of being left or remaining.  E. शिष्ट, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शिष्टत्वं ।
शिष्टसभा: शिष्टसभा f. (-भा) A council of state, an assembly of chief officers.  E. शिष्ट, सभा an assembly.
