शीलवृत्त: शीलवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Noral, steady and uniform in good behaviour. E. शील, वृत्त practice.
शीलसम्पन्न: शीलसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Well-conducted, of proper conduct or dispo-sition.  E. शील, and सम्पन्न abounding with.
शीलित: शीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Skilled, learned, conversant, exercised. 	 2. Having, endowed with. 	 3. Made or consisting of. 	 4. Visited. E. शील् to learn, &c., aff. क्त ।
शीवन्: शीवन् m. (-वा) A large snake, the Boa.  E. शी to sleep, क्वनिप् Unādi aff.
शीवल: शीवल n. (-लं) 	 1. An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) 	 2. Benzoin or Storax. E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वलच् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also शीवाल, &c.
शुंशुमार: शुंशुमार m. (-रः) A porpoise; more usually शिशुमार ।
शु: शु Ind. 	 1. Handsomely, brilliantly, elegantly. 	 2. Well, right.  E. शुभ् to be splendid, aff. ड ।
शुक्: शुक् r. 1st. cl. (शोकति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To touch.
शुक: शुक m. (-कः) 	 1. A parrot. 	 2. The son of VYĀSA, the author or narra-tor of the Bhāgavat. 	 3. The minister of RĀVAṆA. 	 4. The Sirisha tree. 	 5. A plant, commonly Seyāla kāntā. 	 n. (-कं) 	 1. A drug and perfume, commonly Ganthiala. 	 2. Cloth, clothes. 	 3. The ends or hem of a cloth. 	 4. A turban, a helmet. 	 5. A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)  E. शुभ् to shine, कक् Unādi aff., and the radical final rejected.
शुकच्छद: शुकच्छद n. (-दं) A fragrant root, of which various kinds are said to be known.  E. शुक a parrot, and च्छद a cover or wing.
शुकजिह्वा: शुकजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A plant, commonly Sūyā-Thontee or parrot's beak. E. शुक a parrot, and जिह्वा the tongue.
शुकतरु: शुकतरु m. (-रुः) The Sirīsha, (Acacia Sirisha.)  E. शुक the same, and तरु tree.
शुकदेव: शुकदेव m. (-वः) The son of VYĀSA: see शुक,  E. शुक, and देव divine.
शुकद्रुम: शुकद्रुम m. (-मः) The Sirīsha tree: see the last.
शुकनामा: शुकनामा f. (-मा) A plant; see शुकजिह्वा ।
शुकनास: शुकनास m. (-सः) 	 1. A tree, (Bignonia Indica.) 	 2. Another tree, (Sesbana grandiflora.)  E. शुक, and नास the nose, the flowers being compared to a parrot's beak.
शुकपितामह: शुकपितामह m. (-हः) The sage PARĀŚARA, the father of VYĀSA, and grandfather of ŚUKA.
शुकपुच्छ: शुकपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) Sulphur.  E. शुक a parrot, पुच्छ the tail; of similar colour.
शुकपुच्छक: शुकपुच्छक n. (-कं) A perfume and medicinal root, commonly Gānthiāla. E. शुक a parrot, पुच्छ the tail, कन् aff. of comparison.
शुकप्रिया: शुकप्रिया f. (-या) The rose-apple, (Eugenia jambu.)  E. शुक a parrot, प्रिया beloved.
शुकवर्ह: शुकवर्ह n. (-र्हं) Gānthiālā, a perfume.  E. शुक a parrot, वर्ह a tail.
शुकवल्लभ: शुकवल्लभ m. (-भः) The pomegranate.  E. शुक a parrot, and वल्लभ beloved.
शुकवाह: शुकवाह m. (-हः) KĀMADEVA.  E. शुक a parrot, and वाह who is borne.
शुकादन: शुकादन m. (-नः) The pomegranate.  E. शुक a parrot, अदन eating.
शुकानना: शुकानना f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Sūyā-Thontee.  E. शुक a parrot, आनन the face.
शुक्त: शुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Sour, acid. 	 2. Pure, clean. 	 3. Harsh, hard. 	 4. Lovely. 	 5. United, joined. 	 n. (-क्तं) 	 1. Flesh. 	 2. Sour-gruel. 	 3. Vinegar, acid, or an acid preparation made from roots or fruits, by steeping them in oil and salt, drying them, and then leaving them in water, where they undergo the acetous fermentation: the fluid produce is used as vinegar. 	 4. Crabbed or harsh speech. 	 5. A hymn of the Vedas. 	 f. (-क्ता) A sort of sorrel.  E. शुच् to be pure, &c., aff. क्त ।
शुक्ति: शुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 	 1. A pearl-oyster. 	 2. A conch. 	 3. A small shell. 	 4. A cockle. 	 5. A sort of perfume, in appearance a dried shell-fish. 	 6. A portion of the skull used as a cup, &c. 	 7. A curl or feather on a horse's neck or breast. 	 8. A weight of two Karshas or half a Pala. 	 9. A disease of the cornea, formation of specks on it.  E. शुच् to sorrow, &c., aff. क्तिन् ।
शुक्तिका: शुक्तिका f. (-का) 	 1. A pearl-oyster. 	 2. A sort of dock or sorrel.  E. शुक्ति as above, or शुक्त sour, कन् added, fem. form.
शुक्तिज: शुक्तिज n. (-जं) A pearl.  E. शुक्ति the oyster, and ज born.
शुक्तिपुट: शुक्तिपुट n. (-टं) The pearl oyster-shell.  E. शुक्ति, पुट a bag or sheathe.
शुक्तिपेशी: शुक्तिपेशी f. (-शी) The envelope of the pearl or pearl-oyster-shell.  E. शुक्ति, and पेशी a covering.
शुक्तिबधू: शुक्तिबधू f. (-धूः) Mother of pearl or the pearl oyster.  E. शुक्ति, and बधू wife or female; in which the pearl, it is supposed, is bred.
शुक्तिमत्: शुक्तिमत् m. (-मान्) One of the seven principal mountains or mountainous ranges of India.  E. शुक्ति a pearl-oyster, and मतुप् aff.
शुक्तिवीज: शुक्तिवीज n. (-जं) A pearl.  E. शुक्ति the oyster, and वीज a seed.
शुक्तिस्पर्श: शुक्तिस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) Dusky spots on a pearl, causing it to be of little value.  E. शुक्ति a pearl, and स्पर्श contact.
शुक्र: शुक्र m. (-क्रः) 	 1. The planet VENUS or its regent, the son of BHRIGU, and preceptor of the Daityas or Titans. 	 2. A name of fire. 	 3. The month Jyeshṭha, (April-May.) 	 n. (-क्रं) 	 1. Semen virile. 	 2. The essence of anything. 	 3. A morbid affection of the iris, change of colour, ulceration, &c. accompanied by imperfect vision.  E. शुच् to grieve, &c., Unādi aff. रक्, deriv. irr.
शुक्रकर: शुक्रकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Producing semen, spermatic. 	 m. (-रः) The marrow of the bones.  E. शुक्र seed, and कर what makes.
शुक्रभुज्: शुक्रभुज् m. (-भुक्) A peacock.  E. शुक्र semen, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप् ।
शुक्रभू: शुक्रभू f. (-भूः) The marrow of the bones.  E. शुक्र semen, भू being, क्विप् aff.
शुक्रल: शुक्रल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Spermatic, augmenting the seminal secretion. 	 f. (-ला) A fragrant grass, considered by some as a sort of Cyperus, and by others, Zedoary.  E. शुक्र semen, and लच् aff., or ला to get or give, aff. क ।
शुक्रवार: शुक्रवार m. (-रः) Friday.  E. शुक्र ŚUKRA, the regent of VENUS, or the planet, वार a day.
शुक्रशिष्य: शुक्रशिष्य m. (-ष्यः) A demon, a Titau, a powerful being opposed to the gods.  E. शुक्र the teacher of this race, and शिष्य a pupil.
शुक्रिय: शुक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sacred to ŚUKRA, &c.  E. शुक्र as above, घन् aff.
शुक्राचार्य: शुक्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The regent of VENUS.  E. शुक्र, and आचार्य्य teacher.
शुक्राचार्य्य: शुक्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The regent of VENUS.  E. शुक्र, and आचार्य्य teacher.
शुक्ल: शुक्ल mfn. (-क्लः-क्ला-क्लं) White, of a white colour. 	 m. (-क्लः) 	 1. White, (the colour.) 	 2. The light-half of a lunar month: see शुक्लपक्ष. 	 3. One of the astronomical Yogas. 	 n. (-क्लं) 	 1. Silver. 	 2. Fresh butter. 	 3. A disease of the cornea, opacity, albugo. 	 4. Sour gruel. 	 f. (-क्ला) 	 1. A name of SARASWATI. 	 2. Clayed or candied sugar. 	 3. A woman with white complexion.  E. शुच् to be pure, &c., Unādi aff. रन्, and र changed to ल ।
शुक्लक: शुक्लक f. (-का) White. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. The white colour. 	 2. The light-half of a lunar month.
शुक्लकण्ठक: शुक्लकण्ठक m. (-कः) A kind of gallinule or water-hen.  E. शुक्ल white, कण्ठ the throat, and कन् aff.
शुक्लकर्मन्: शुक्लकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Innocent, virtuous.  E. शुक्ल white, pure, and कर्म्मन् act.
शुक्लकर्म्मन्: शुक्लकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Innocent, virtuous.  E. शुक्ल white, pure, and कर्म्मन् act.
शुक्लत्व: शुक्लत्व n. (-त्वं) Whiteness.  E. शुक्ल white, त्व aff.; also with तल् aff. शुक्लता ।
शुक्लदुग्ध: शुक्लदुग्ध m. (-ग्धः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.)  E. शुक्ल white, दुग्ध milk. “शृङ्गाटके ।”
शुक्लधातु: शुक्लधातु m. (-तुः) Chalk.  E. शुक्ल white, and धातु a mineral.
शुक्लपक्ष: शुक्लपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The light-half of a month, the fifteen days of the moon's increase, or from new to full-moon.  E. शुक्ल white, पक्ष part or fortnight.
शुक्लपुष्प: शुक्लपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 	 1. The white variety of Amaranth, (Gomphrœna globosa.) 	 2. A species of jasmine, (Jasminum pubescens.) 	 f. (-ष्पा) 1. A shrub, (Phrynium dichotomum.) 	 2. A sort of sun-flower. E. शुक्ल white, and पुष्प a flower.
शुक्लपृष्ठक: शुक्लपृष्ठक m. (-कः) A small tree, (Vitex nigundo.)
शुक्लबल: शुक्लबल m. (-लः) A name common to nine persons peculiar to the Jainas.  E. शुक्ल white, and बल a BALADEVA; there being nine white BALADEVAS, corresponding to the nine KRISHṆAS, or black VĀSUDEVAS, according to the notions of this sect.
शुक्लमण्डल: शुक्लमण्डल n. (-लं) The white of the eye, the cornea.  E. शुक्ल white, मण्डल a circle.
शुक्लवर्ग: शुक्लवर्ग m. (-र्गः) 	 1. A class of white objects, or the conch, pearl-oyster and cowrie, &c.  E. शुक्ल white, and वर्ग a class.
शुक्लवायस: शुक्लवायस m. (-सः) A crane.  E. शुक्ल white, and वायस a crow.
शुक्लाङ्ग: शुक्लाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having a white body or limbs. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) A pea-cock.  E. शुक्ल white, and अङ्ग body.
शुक्लापाङ्ग: शुक्लापाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A peacock.  E. शुक्ल white, अपाङ्ग the corner of the eye.
शुक्लाम्ल: शुक्लाम्ल n. (-म्लं) A kind of sorrel.
शुक्लिमन्: शुक्लिमन् m. (-मा) Whiteness.  E. शुक्ल white, इमनिच् aff.
शुक्लीकरण: शुक्लीकरण n. (-णं) Whitening, making white.  E. शुक्ल, करण making, च्वि aff.
शुक्लीकृत: शुक्लीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made white, whitened.  E. शुक्ल, कृत made, च्वि aff.
शुक्लोपला: शुक्लोपला f. (-ला) 	 1. Clayed or candied sugar. 	 2. Any white stone.  E. शुक्ल white, and उपला a stone.
शुक्षि: शुक्षि m. (-क्षिः) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. Light.  E. शुष् to dry up, Unādi aff. क्सि ।
शुङ्ग: शुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The Indian-fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 	 2. The hog-plum, (Spondias mangifera.) 	 f. (-ङ्गा) 	 1. The sheath or calyx of a young bud. 	 2. The waved-leaf fig. 	 3. The awn of barley, &c.  E. शम् to rest or pacify, aff. गच्; form irr.
शुङ्गिन्: शुङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) The Indian-fig tree.  E. शुङ्ग the calyx of the bud, इनि aff.
शुच्: शुच् r. 1st cl. (शोचति) To regret, to grieve for. (ई, इर) ईशूचिर r. 4th cl. (शुच्यति-ते) 	 1. To be wet. 	 2. To be clean or pure. 	 3. To stink, to be fetid. 	 4. To wound. 	 5. To regret.
शुच् f. (-शुक्) 	 1. Sorrow, grief, distress, regret. 	 2. Calamity, affliction. E. शुच् to regret, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added, शुचा f. (-चा) ।
शुचा: शुचा f. (-चा) Sorrow, distress: see शुच् ।
शुचि: शुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) 	 1. White. 	 2. Clean, cleansed, purified. 	 3. Pure, pious, exempt from passion or vice. 	 4. Correct, free from fault or error. 	 m. (-चिः) 	 1. White, (the colour.) 	 2. Purification by ablution, &c. 	 3. Judicial acquittal. 	 4. Mental purity, virtue, goodness. 	 5. Accuracy, correctness. 	 6. The condition of the reli-gious student. 	 7. A faithful and tried minister or friend. 	 8. The month Āshādha, (June-July.) 	 9. The month Jyeshṭha, (May-June.) 	 10. The hot season. 	 11. The passion or sentiment of love. 12. ŚIVA. 	 13. The sun. 	 14. The moon. 	 15. The planet VENUS, or its ruler. 	 16. A name of fire. 	 17. A Brāhman. 	 18. Oblation to fire at the first feeding of an infant.  E. शुच् to purify, Unādi aff. इन्, and the vowel unchanged; or शुच्-कि ।
शुचित: शुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Sad, lamenting. 	 2. Pure, clean, cleansed. E. शुच् to grieve, क्त aff.
शुचिता: शुचिता f. (-ता) Purity, cleanness.  E. शुचि, तल् aff.; also with त्व, शुचित्वं ।
शुचिप्रणी: शुचिप्रणी f. (-णी) Sipping water, rinsing the mouth, &c.  E. शुचि purifi-cation, and प्रणी effecting.
शुचिमणि: शुचिमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal.  E. शुचि white, and मणि a gem.
शुचिरोचिस्: शुचिरोचिस् m. (-चीः) The moon.  E. शुचि white, and रोचिस् light.
शुचिव्रत: शुचिव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pious, virtuous.  E. शुचि, and व्रत observance.
शुचिस्मित: शुचिस्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smiled, smiling sweetly, accompanied with a sweet smile.  E. शुचि white, (from the teeth being shewn,) and स्मित smiled.
शुच्य: शुच्य(इ)शुच्यी r. 1st cl. (शुच्यति) 	 1. To bathe. 	 2. To distil. 	 3. To press or squeeze out. 	 4. To churn. 	 5. To pain or distress.
शुटीर: शुटीर m. (-रः) A hero.  E. शौटीर-पृषो० ।
शुटीरता: शुटीरता f. (-ता) Valour, heroism.  E. शौटीर a hero, तल् aff., and the diph-thong changed to the short vowel.
शुटीर्य: शुटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Heroism, prowess.  E. शौटीर a hero, यत् aff.: see the last.
शुटीर्य्य: शुटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Heroism, prowess.  E. शौटीर a hero, यत् aff.: see the last.
शुठ्: शुठ् r. 1st cl. (शोठति) 	 1. To be impeded. 	 2. To be lame. 	 3. To resist. r. 10th cl. (शोठयति-ते) To be idle, to be lazy; also (इ) शुठि r. 1st and 10th cls. (शुण्ठति-शुण्ठयति-ते) To purify.
शुण्ठि: शुण्ठि f. (-ण्ठिः-ण्ठी) Dry ginger.  E. शुठि to be stopped, (by it, phlegm,) aff. अच्, and fem. aff. ङीप्, or in one case इन् aff.
शुण्ठ्य: शुण्ठ्य n. (-ण्ठ्यं) Dry ginger.  E. शुठि to be stopped, (disease by it,) and यत् aff.
शुण्ड: शुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The exudation from an elephant's temples. 	 f. (-ण्डा) 	 1. A tavern. 	 2. Spirituous liquor. 	 3. A liquor-shop. 	 4. An animal called the water-elephant, the hippopotamus perhaps. 	 5. An elephant's proboscis or trunk. 	 6. The stalk of the lotus. 	 7. A whore. 	 8. A bawd.  E. शुण् to go, aff. ड, fem. aff. टाप् ।
शुण्डक: शुण्डक m. (-कः) 	 1. A distiller. 	 2. A military flute or fife.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
शुण्डापान: शुण्डापान n. (-नं) A place where spirits are sold, a tavern, a dram-shop. E. शुण्डा spirits, and पान drinking.
शुण्डार: शुण्डार m. (-रः) 	 1. A distiller, a vintner. 	 2. An elephant's proboscis.  E. शुण्डा spirits, र aff.
शुण्डाल: शुण्डाल m. (-लः) An elephant.  E. शुण्डा his trunk, लच् poss. aff.
शुण्डिका: शुण्डिका f. (-कां) The soft palate.  E. शुण्डा an elephant's proboscis, कन् fem. form.
शुण्डिन्: शुण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) 	 1. A distiller, a preparer and vender of spirituous liquor. 	 2. An elephant.  E. शुण्डा spirits, &c., इनि aff.
शुतुद्रि: शुतुद्रि f. (-द्रिः) The river Śatadru or Sutlej: see शतद्रु ।
शुद्ध: शुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 	 1. Pure, purified, clean, cleansed. 	 2. Faultless, correct. 	 3. Alone, only, mere, simple. 	 4. White. 	 5. Whetted, sharp, (as an arrow.) 	 6. Authorised, admitted. 	 7. Innocent. 	 8. Acquitted. 	 9. Bright. 	 10. Honest, chaste. 	 n. (-द्धं) 	 1. Pure spirit. 	 2. Rock-salt. 	 3. Black pepper.  E. शुध् to be or make pure, &c., aff. क्त ।
शुद्धकोटि: शुद्धकोटि f. (-टिः) One of the sides of a right-angled triangle.  E. शुद्ध, and कोटि flank.

शृगालिका: शृगालिका f. (-का) 	 1. The female jackal. 	 2. A fox. 	 3. Running away, flight, retreat. 	 4. A plant, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)  E. शृगाली as above, and कन् added.
शृङ्खल: शृङ्खल Subst. 	 mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. A belt or chain worn round a man's body. 	 2. A chain for confining an elephant. 	 3. A chain, a fetter in general.  E. शृङ्ग a horn, here said to mean a link, and खल् to collect, aff. अच्; or शिञ्जा the tinkling of a chain, and स्खल् to go, aff. अच्, deriv irr.

शृङ्खलता: शृङ्खलता f. (-ता) 	 1. Connexion, concatenation. 	 2. Restraint.  E. तल् added to शृङ्खल; also with त्व, शृङ्खलत्वं ।
शृङ्खलित: शृङ्खलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, chained, fettered, captive.  E. शृङ्खला a chain, इतच् aff.
शृङ्ग: शृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. A horn. 	 2. A mark, a sign. 	 3. The top of a mountain. 4. The summit of a building. 	 5. Any point or projection. 	 6. A horn of the moon. 	 7. A horn used as a wind-instrument. 	 8. Sover-eignty, mastership. 	 9. Dignity, elevation. 	 10. A fountain, an artificial one or jet d'eau. 	 11. A lotus. 	 12. Very sharp. 	 13. Minutely fine. 	 14. Excess of love. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A medicinal root, commonly Jivaka. 	 2. A Muni so named. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. Gold. 	 2. A fish, (Silurus Singio, HAM.) 	 3. A plant (Betula.) 	 4. Rishabha, a medicinal root, sharped like a bull's horn. 	 5. Another plant, a kind of Rhus, with an excrescence or gall in the bark, compared to a crab's horn.  E. शॄ to injure, Unādi aff. गन्, and the vowel made short.
शृङ्गक: शृङ्गक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A horn. 	 2. Any pointed object. 	 3. A horn of the moon. 	 m. (-कः) A medicinal root, commonly Jivaka.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
शृङ्गज: शृङ्गज m. (-जः) An arrow. 	 n. (-जं) Aloe-wood.
शृङ्गला: शृङ्गला f. (-ला) A plant, a kind of Rhus, having an excrescence in the bark formed by an insect, which is compared in shape to the horn of a goat or a crab.  E. शृङ्ग a horn, लच् aff.
शृङ्गवेर: शृङ्गवेर n. (-रं) Ginger.  E. शृङ्ग a horn, and वेर body or shape; also with कन् added शृङ्गवेरक ।
शृङ्गाट: शृङ्गाट n. (-टं) A place where four roads meet. 	 m. (-टः) 	 1. An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) 	 2. A shrub, (Ruellia or Barleria longifo-lia.)  E. शृङ्ग a horn, अट् to go or be, aff. अच् ।
शृङ्गाटक: शृङ्गाटक n. (-कं) 	 1. A place where four roads meet. 	 2. An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) 	 3. A door. 	 m. (-कः) A collection or mountain of three peaks.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
शृङ्गान्तर: शृङ्गान्तर n. (-रं) The interval between the horns of an animal.
शृङ्गार: शृङ्गार m. (-रः) 	 1. Love, the passion or sentiment as an object of poeti-cal description or dramatic representation. 	 2. Copulation, coition. 3. Marks made with red-lead on an elephant's head and trunk by way of ornament. 	 4. A dress suitable for amorous purposes. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. Cloves. 	 2. Red-lead. 	 3. Fragrant powder for the dress or person. 	 4. Ginger. 	 5. Agallochum.  E. शृङ्ग eminence, dignity, ऋ to go to or obtain, and अण् aff.; being the chief of the poetical Rasas; or शॄ to hurt, आरन् Unādi aff., with नुम् and गुक् augments.
शृङ्गारक: शृङ्गारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Horned, having a horn or crest.  E. शृङ्ग, आरकन् poss. aff.
शृङ्गारभूषण: शृङ्गारभूषण n. (-णं) Red-lead.  E. शृङ्गार love, भूषण adorning. “सिन्दुरे ।”
शृङ्गारयोनि: शृङ्गारयोनि m. (-निः) The deity of love.  E. शृङ्गार the passion, योनि origin.
शृङ्गारवेश: शृङ्गारवेश m. (-शः) A dress suitable for amorous purposes.
शृङ्गारसहाय: शृङ्गारसहाय m. (-यः) An assistant in love affairs.
शृङ्गारित: शृङ्गारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Stained with red-lead, reddened. 	 2. Deco-rated. 	 3. Affected with passion.  E. शृङ्गार, and इतच् aff.
शृङ्गारिन्: शृङ्गारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 	 1. Feeling or relating to the passion of love. 	 2. Stained with red-lead. 	 m. (-री) 	 1. An empassioned lover. 2. Dress, decoration. 	 3. An elephant. 	 4. A ruby. 	 5. The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.)  E. शृङ्गार love, इनि aff. of relation.
शृङ्गि: शृङ्गि f. (-ङ्गिः or -ङ्गी) 	 1. A sort of sheat-fish, (Silurus Singio, HAM.) 	 2. A kind of poison. 	 mn. (-ङ्गिः-ङ्गि) Gold for ornaments: see शृङ्ग, शृङ्गी ।
शृङ्गिक: शृङ्गिक n. (-कं) A sort of poison. 	 f. (-का) A plant, (Betula.)  E. शृङ्क a fish, &c., ठञ् aff.
शृङ्गिकनक: शृङ्गिकनक n. (-कं) Gold for ornaments.  E. शृङ्गि the same, and कनक gold.
शृङ्गिण: शृङ्गिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Horned. 	 m. (-णः) A ram.  E. शृङ्ग a horn, इनन् aff.
शृङ्गिन्: शृङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) 	 1. Horned. 	 2. Crested, peaked. 	 m. (-ङ्गी) 	 1. An elephant. 	 2. A mountain. 	 3. A tree. 	 4. An epithet of ŚIVA. 5. Name of an attendant of ŚIVA. 	 f. (-ङ्गिणी) 	 1. A cow. 	 2. Arabian jasmine. 	 3. Heart-pea. 	 4. Katuki, a medicinal plant. E. शृङ्ग a horn, &c., इनि poss. aff.
शृणि: शृणि f. (-णिः) The hook for goading an elephant.  E. शृ to injure, नि aff., and the radical vowel made short; also सृणि ।
शृण्वत्: शृण्वत् mfn. (-ण्वन्-ण्वन्ती-ण्वत्) Hearing.  E. श्रु to hear, शतृ aff.
शृत: शृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Boiled, (water, milk or Ghee.)  E. श्रा to boil, aff. क्त, form irr.; or शृ-क्त; as applied to any other substances, the form is श्राण or श्रपित ।
शृध्: शृध्(उ)शृधु r. 1st. cl. (शर्द्धते) To fart. (शर्द्धति-ते) To cut. r. 10th cl. (शर्द्धयति-ते) 	 1. To insult, to ridicule. 	 2. To take, to seize.
शृधु: शृधु f. (-धुः) 	 1. The anus. 	 2. Intellect.  E. शृध् to fart, &c., Unādi aff. कू; also read शृधू ।
शॄ: शॄ r. 9th cl. (शृणाति) To hurt, to wound or kill. With वि prefixed, pass. v. (विशीर्य्यते) To be injured or impaired, to waste or decay.
शेखर: शेखर m. (-रः) 	 1. A garland of flowers worn on the crown of the head. 2. A crest. 	 3. The burden of a song. 	 4. Anything the best of its kind, (when used at the end of a compound.) 	 f. (-री) A parasite plant. 	 n. (-रं) 	 1. The root of the Hyperanthera morunga. 	 2. Cloves.  E. शिखि to go, अरन् aff.; the nasal omitted.
शेखरित: शेखरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Crested, tufted, peaked.  E. शेखर, इतच् aff.
शेप: शेप m. (-पः) 	 1. The penis. 	 2. A testicle.  E. शी to sleep, पन् aff.: see शेफस्; also read शेपस् n. (-पः) ।
शेफ: शेफ m. (-फः) The penis.  E. शी to sleep, फन् aff.: see the next.
शेफस्: शेफस् n. (-फः) The penis.  E. शी to sleep, (semine effuso,) असुन् aff., and फुट् augment; also with पुट् augment, शेपस्, and with a final vowel, शेफ or शेप; again, व being substituted for प, शेव ।
शेफालि: शेफालि f. (-लिः-ली) A plant: see the next.
शेफालिका: शेफालिका f. (-का) A flower, (Nyctanthes arbor-tristis.)  E. शेफा sleeping, from शी with फ aff., अलि a bee, fem. aff. ङीष्, कप् added; also शेफालि ।
शेमुषी: शेमुषी f. (-षी) Understanding, intellect.  E. शे derived from शीङ् to sleep, with the aff. विच्, implying ignorance or delusion and मुष् to steal, to take away, affs. क and ङीष्; or शम् to pacify, (the senses,) क्कसु participial aff., fem. form, deriv. irr.
शेल्: शेल्(ऋ)शेऌ r. 1st cl. (शेलति) 	 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To shake, to tremble.
शेलु: शेलु m. (-लुः) A small tree, (Cordia myxa.)  E. शिल् to glean, उन् aff.
शेव: शेव m. (-वः) 	 1. The penis. 	 2. A snake. 	 3. Heighth, elevation. 	 4. Happi-ness. 	 n. (-वं) 	 1. The penis. 	 2. Happiness. Ind. (-वम्) Hail, homage, a term of exclamation or salutation addressed to the deities. E. शीङ् to sleep, Unādi aff. वन् ।

शेवल: शेवल n. (-लं) 	 1. An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra:) see the next. 	 2. The green moss-like substance that grows on the surface of water.
शेवाल: शेवाल n. (-लं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.)  E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वालन् Unādi aff.; also व being changed to प, शेपाल, and the pen. vowel shortened, शेवल; also शैवल, &c.
शेश्यित: शेश्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fast asleep, sleeping much.  E. शी to sleep, intens. v., क्त aff.
शेश्यितवत्: शेश्यितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sleeping much or soundly.  E. शी to sleep, intens. v., क्तवतु aff.
शेश्वीयमान: शेश्वीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Enlarging, expanding.  E. श्वि to increase, intens. v., शानच् aff.
शेष: शेष n. (-षं) Remainder, leavings, rest, balance, what is left, omitted or rejected. 	 m. (-षः) 	 1. The king of the serpent race, as a large thousand-headed snake, at once the couch and canopy of VISHṆU, and the upholder of the world, which rests on one of his heads. 2. A name of BALADEVA. 	 3. Killing, destroying, finishing. 	 4. Result, end, conclusion. 	 f. (-षा) Flowers and other things that have been offered to an idol and are then distributed amongst the worshippers and attendants.  E. शिष् to specify, aff. अच् or घञ् ।

शेषभाग: शेषभाग m. (-गः) The last or remaining part.  E. शेष and भाग portion.
शेषभुज्: शेषभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Who eats the leavings of others.  E. शेष, भुज् who eats.
शेषभोजन: शेषभोजन n. (-नं) 	 1. Eating the rest of the food after feeding the family, guests, &c. 	 2. Eating the leavings of a meal.  E. शेष and भोजन food.
शेषरक्षण: शेषरक्षण n. (-णं) Taking care that an undertaking is brought to a conclusion.  E. शेष and रक्षण preserving.
शेषरात्रि: शेषरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) The last watch of the night.  E. शेष the remainder, and रात्रि night.
शेषशयन: शेषशयन m. (-नः) An epithet of VISHṆU.
शेषान्न: शेषान्न n. (-न्नं) Leavings of a meal, &c.  E. शेष, अन्न food.
शेषावस्था: शेषावस्था f. (-स्था) The last state or condition of life.  E. शेष and अवस्था state.
शैक्ष: शैक्ष m. (-क्षः) A young Brāhman in his novitiate, one who has begun to read the Vedas.  E. शिक्षा the pronunciation of the language of the Vedas, अण् aff.
शैख: शैख m. (-खः) The offspring of an outcaste Brāhman.
शैखरिक: शैखरिक m. (-कः) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)  E. शेखर a crest or top, ठक् aff.; also with ढक् aff. शैखरेय ।
शैत्य: शैत्य n. (-त्यं) Cold, coldness.  E. शीत cold, and ष्यञ् aff.
शैथिल्य: शैथिल्य n. (-ल्यं) 	 1. Looseness, laxity. 	 2. Flaccidity. 	 3. Slackness, remission. 	 4. Relaxation of rule or connexion.  E. शिथिल, ष्यञ् aff.
शैनेय: शैनेय m. (-यः) SĀTYAKI, the charioteer of KRISHṆA.
शैरीयक: शैरीयक m. (-कः) A shrub, (Barleria cristata;) also शैरेयक ।
शैल: शैल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) 	 1. Mountainous, mountaineer, &c. 	 2. Stony, rocky. m. (-लः) A mountain. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Bitumen. 	 2. Storax. 	 3. A sort of collyrium: see रसाञ्जन. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. A concise interpretation of a grammatical aphorism. 	 2. A mode of interpretation. 	 3. Course, conduct.  E. शिला a rock, a stone, अण् aff.
शैलक: शैलक n. (-कं) 	 1. Storax or Benzoin. 	 2. Bitumen.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
शैलकटक: शैलकटक m. (-कः) The brow or slope of a mountain.  E. शैल, कटक flank.
शैलज: शैलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in or on mountains, rocks, &c. 	 n. (-जं) 	 1. A fragrant resinous substance, (Storax or Benzoin.) 	 2. Bitumen. E. शैल a mountain, and ज produced.
शैलजन: शैलजन m. (-नः) A mountaineer.  E. शैल, and जन a person.
शैलधन्वन्: शैलधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) ŚIVA.  E. शैल a mountain, and धन्वन् a bow.
शैलधर: शैलधर m. (-रः) KRISHṆA.  E. शैल a mountain, and धर who upholds.

शैलनिर्य्यास: शैलनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) Storax, Benzoin.  E. शैल a rock, निर्य्यास exudation.
शैलपति: शैलपति m. (-तिः) The Himālaya.  E. शैल, and पति master.

शैलमय: शैलमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Rocky.  E. शैल, and मयट् aff.

शैलशिखर: शैलशिखर n. (-रं) The crest or peak of a mountain.  E. शैल, शिखर a peak.
शैलशिविर: शैलशिविर n. (-रं) The ocean.  E. शैल a rock, and शिविर a camp or place.
शैलशृङ्ग: शैलशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The peak of a mountain.  E. शैल, and शृङ्ग a horn.
शैलसार: शैलसार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard, firm, as a rock.  E. शैल and सार essence.
शैलाग्र: शैलाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The peak of a mountain.  E. शैल a mountain, and अग्र top.

शैलूष: शैलूष m. (-षः) 	 1. An actor, a dancer, a tumbler, &c. 	 2. A rogue, a cheat. 	 3. The master of the band, or one who beats time. 	 4. The Bel-tree, (Ægle marmelos.)  E. शिलूष one of the early teachers of the arts of acting, &c., अण् aff. of descent.
शैलूषिक: शैलूषिक m. (-कः) One who follows the profession of an actor.  E. शैलूष, ठक् aff.
शैलेय: शैलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 	 1. Produced in the mountains, &c., mountain-ous, mountaineer. 	 2. Mountain-like. 	 n. (-यः) 	 1. A fragrant resin, (Stcrax or Benzoin.) 	 2. शैल्य: शैल्य nf. (-ल्यं-ल्यी) Hardness, stoniness.  E. शिला a stone, a rock, ष्यञ् aff.

शैशव: शैशव n. (-वं) Childhood, pupilage, the period under sixteen.  E. शिशु a child, अण् aff.
शैशिर: शैशिर f. (-री) Adj. Relating of the dewy-season. 	 m. (-रः) A species of chātaka bird.  E. शिशिर, अण् aff.

शोकच्छिद्: शोकच्छिद् mfn. (-च्छिद्) Consoling, allaying, removing sorrow.  E. शोक, and च्छिद् what cuts.
शोकनिहत: शोकनिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Afflicted, overcome with grief.  E. शोक, and निहत struck.
शोकभङ्ग: शोकभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Dissipating or removing sorrow.  E. शोक, and भङ्ग breaking.
शोकमूर्च्छित: शोकमूर्च्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Involved in distress, swooning with grief. E. शोक, and मूर्च्छित fained.
शोकस्थान: शोकस्थान n. (-नं) Site, circumstance, or occasion of sorrow.  E. शोक, and स्थान place.
शोकाकुल: शोकाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Overcome with sorrow.  E. शोक, and आकुल bewildered.
शोकाग्नि: शोकाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Deep distress, violent grief.  E. शोक and अग्नि fire; also similar compounds, as शोकानल, &c.
शोकाग्निसन्तप्त: शोकाग्निसन्तप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Distressed.  E. शोकाग्नि, and सन्तप्त inflamed.
शोकापनुद: शोकापनुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 	 1. Alleviating, consoling. 	 2. Being consoled. E. शोक, and अपनुद what drives away.
शोकापनोद: शोकापनोद m. (-दः) A teacher of holy wisdom, a philosopher.  E. शोक worldly care, अप away, नुद् to send, घञ् aff.
शोकापहर्तृ: शोकापहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) Allaying or dissipating grief.  E. शोक, and अपहर्त्तृ what drives away.
शोकापहर्त्तृ: शोकापहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ) Allaying or dissipating grief.  E. शोक, and अपहर्त्तृ what drives away.
शोकारि: शोकारि m. (-रिः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Kadamba.)  E. शोक sorrow, अरि hostile.
शोकार्त: शोकार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained, afflicted by sorrow.  E. शोक, and आर्त्त pained.
शोकार्त्त: शोकार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained, afflicted by sorrow.  E. शोक, and आर्त्त pained.
शोकोद्भव: शोकोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from or caused by grief. E. शोक, and उद्भव produced.
शोचन: शोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sorrowing, sorrowful. 	 n. (-नं) Sorrow, grief, grie-ving.  E. शुच् to grieve, aff. युच् or ल्युट् ।
शोचनीय: शोचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be grieved or lamented.  E. शुच् to be sad, अनीयर् aff.
शोचित: शोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sorrowful, afflicted.  E. शुचि to grieve, causal v., क्त aff.
शोचितव्य: शोचितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be grieved for, lamentable.  E. शुच् to grieve, तव्य aff.
शोचित्वा: शोचित्वा Ind. Grieving or having grieved for.  E. शुचि to lament, क्त्वा aff.
शोचिष्केश: शोचिष्केश m. (-शः) Fire or its deity.  E. शोचिस् light, and केश hair, having locks of flame.
शोचिस्: शोचिस् n. (-चिः) Light, lustre, radiance, flame.  E. शुच् to be or make pure, Unādi aff. इसि ।
शोच्य: शोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 	 1. To be lamented or bewailed. 	 2. To be clean-sed or purified. 	 3. Low, vile.  E. शुच् to grieve, ण्यत् aff.
शोच्यक: शोच्यक m. (-कः) A low man.  E. शोच्य to be purified, (from,) कन् aff.
शोठ: शोठ m. (-ठः) 	 1. A fool, a blockhead. 	 2. A sluggard. 	 3. A rogue, a cheat. 	 4. A low man, one of a degraded tribe or business. 	 5. A villain, a criminal, a sinner. 	 f. (-ठा) 	 1. Foolish. 	 2. Wicked. 	 3. Lazy, idle.  E. शुठ् to be prevented or stopped, aff. अच् ।
शोण्: शोण्(ऋ)शोणृ r. 1st cl. (शोणति) 	 1. To be red. 	 2. To move or approach.
शोण: शोण mfn. (-णः-णा or णी-णं) 	 1. Crimson, of a crimson colour. 	 2. Red in the face, from passion, &c. 	 m. (-णः) 	 1. Crimson, the colour of the red lotus. 	 2. A horse of a reddish or bright chesnut colour. 	 3. The Śona river, which rises in the table land of Amerakantāk and running first northerly and then easterly for 500 miles, falls into the Ganges above Pātnā. 	 4. A flower, (Bignonia Indica.) 	 5. Fire or its deity. 	 6. An ocean. 	 7. A red sort of sugar-cane. 	 8. The planet Mars. 	 n. (-णं) 	 1. Red-lead. 	 2. Blood.  E. शोण् to be red, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीप् ।
शोणक: शोणक m. (-कः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
शोणरत्न: शोणरत्न n. (-त्नं) A ruby.  E. शोण deep red, and रत्न a gem.
शोणाक: शोणाक m. (-कः) A tree, (Bignonia Indica.)  E. शोण red, अक् to go or be, aff. अच्.
शोणाम्बु: शोणाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) Name of a cloud which would rise at the destruction of the world.
शोणित: शोणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Red, crimson, purple. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Blood. 	 2. Saff-ron.  E. शोण redness, इतच् aff.
शोणितप: शोणितप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Who or what drinks blood.  E. शोणित and पा to drink, क aff.
शोणितपुर: शोणितपुर n. (-रं) The city of Vānāsura.  E. शोणित red, and पुर city.
शोणितोक्षित: शोणितोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stained or sprinkled with blood.  E. शोणित, and उक्षित moistened.
शोणितोपल: शोणितोपल n. (-लं) A ruby.  E. शोणित red, and उपल a stone.
शोणिमन्: शोणिमन् m. (-मा) Redness.  E. शोण् and इमनिच् aff.
शोथ: शोथ m. (-थः) Swelling, intumescence.  E. शु to go, (to grow,) Unādi aff. थन्; also with कन् added, शोथक m. (-कः) ।
शोथघ्न: शोथघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Discutient, removing swellings. 	 f. (-घ्नी) Hogweed, (Boerhavia diffusa.)  E. शोथ swelling, घ्न removing, fem. aff. ङीष् ।
शोथजित्: शोथजित् mfn. (-जित्) Discutient. 	 f. (-जित्) Hogweed: see the last. E. शोथ swelling, and जित् overcoming.
शोथहृत्: शोथहृत् mfn. (-हृत्) Discutient, removing swelling. 	 m. (-हृत्) Marking-nut plant.  E. शोथ swelling. and हृत् removing.
शोध: शोध m. (-धः) 	 1. Purification. 	 2. Correction. 	 3. Retalition. 	 4. Acquittance.
शोधक: शोधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what cleans, purifies, &c. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A refiner. 	 2. (In arithmetic,) The subtrahend. 	 n. (-कं) A kind of earth.  E. शुध् to be pure, ण्वुल् aff.
शोधन: शोधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cleaning, purifying &c., that which cleanses, refines, &c. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Cleaning, cleansing, purifying. 	 2. Correcting, freeing from faults or errors. 	 3. Correcting, as a writing. 	 4. Subtrac-tion, (in arithmetic.) 	 5. The refining of metals. 	 6. A sort of refining, practised for chemical or medical purposes: exposing the metals to heat, and then sprinkling them with the urine of cows, &c. 	 7. Pay-ment, acquittance. 	 8. Feces, ordure. 	 9. Green vitriol. 	 10. Deter-mination. 	 11. Punishment. 	 12. Expiation. 	 m. (-नः) The lime. 	 f. (-नी) A broom.  E. शुध् to be make pure, aff. ल्युट् or युच् ।
शोधनीय: शोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 	 1. To be corrected. 	 2. To be cleansed or purified. 3. To be refined. 	 4. To be subtracted. 	 5. To be liquidated, (as a debt,) due.  E. शुध् to purify, aff. अनीयर्; also शोध्य and शोधितव्य ।
शोधयित्वा: शोधयित्वा Ind. 	 1. Having paid or discharged. 	 2. Having cleared, &c. E. शुध् to be pure, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
शोधित: शोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Cleaned, cleansed. 	 2. Strained. 	 3. Corrected. 4. Refined. 	 5. Purified. 	 6. Discharged, liquidated, (as a debt.) E. शुध् to clean, aff. क्त ।
शोध्य: शोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 	 1. To be purified, cleaned, refined, &c. 	 2. Payable, due. 	 3. To be subtracted. 	 m. (-ध्यः) An accused person, one to be justified or tried. 	 n. (-ध्यं) A constant number to be subtracted in some astronomical computation.  E. शुध् to be pure, यत् aff.
शोफ: शोफ m. (-फः) Intumescence, swelling.  E. शु to go, aff. फन् ।
शोभ: शोभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 	 1. Handsome. 	 2. Bright. 	 f. (-भा) 	 1. Light, lustre, radiance, splendour. 	 2. Beauty. 	 3. Distinguished merit. 	 4. A species of the Kriti-metre.  E. शुभ् to shine, aff. अच्, fem. aff. टाप् ।
शोभकृत्: शोभकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Beautifying. 	 m. (-कृत्) 	 1. The thirty-sixth year of the Hindu cycle. 	 2. Marking-nut plant.  E. शोभ handsome, and कृत् what makes.
शोभन: शोभन mfn. (-नः-ना or नी-नं) 	 1. Beautiful, handsome. 	 2. Shining, splendid. 3. Richly dressed or ornamented. 	 4. Propitious, auspicious. 	 5. Virtu-ous, moral, decorous, good. 	 m. (-नः) 	 1. The fifth Yoga. 	 2. A planet. 3. Burnt-offering for auspicious results. 	 4. A name of ŚIVA. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. A lotus. 	 2. Shining, being splendid or handsome. 	 f. (-ना) 1. A virtuous or beautiful woman. 	 2. Turmeric. 	 3. A kind of Pig-ment, commonly called Gorochanā.  E. शुभ् to shine, aff. ल्यु ।
शोभनक: शोभनक m. (-कः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)  E. कन् added to the preceding. “शजिना गाछ ।”
शोभनाचरित: शोभनाचरित n. (-तं) Virtuous practice.  E. शोभन, and आचरित done.
शोभमान: शोभमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fair, splendid, shining.  E. शुभ् to shine, &c., शानच् aff.
शोभा: शोभा f. (-भा) 	 1. Light, lustre. 	 2. Beauty, grace, loveliness. 	 3. Grandeur. 4. Turmeric. 	 5. The Pigment called “गोरोचना.”  E. शुभ्, अ aff.
शोभाञ्जन: शोभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, commonly Sajina or Sahajnā, (Hyperanthera morunga;) the legumes, blossoms, and leaves are esculent, and the root of the young tree is used as a substitute for horse-radish: in medicine the root is used as a rubefacient externally, as a stimulant internally, and the expressed oil of the seeds is employed to relieve arthritic pains, &c.  E. शोभा beauty, अञ्ज् to pervade or anoint, and ल्युट् or युच् aff.; also शौभाञ्जन and सोभाञ्जन, &c.
शोभित: शोभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beautified, decorated.  E. शुभ् to shine, क्त aff.
शोलि: शोलि f. (-लिः or -ली) Wild turmeric.  E. शूल-अच् पृषो० ङीष् ।
शोशुच्यमान: शोशुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sorrowing or grieving deeply.  E. शुच् to be sorrowful, intens. v., शानच् aff.
शोष: शोष m. (-षः) 	 1. Pulmonary consumption. 	 2. Drying up, dryness. 	 3. Intumescence, swelling. 	 4. Emaciation, withering.  E. शुष् to dry, aff. घञ् ।
शोषण: शोषण n. (-णं) 	 1. Suction, sucking. 	 2. Drying up. 	 3. Exhaustion. 	 4. Dry-ginger. 	 m. (-णः) One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA, or CUPID. f. (-णी) 	 1. Drying up. 	 2. Causing to wither.  E. शुष् to dry, ल्युट् aff.
शोषयित्वा: शोषयित्वा Ind. Having dried up.  E. शुष् to dry, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
शोषित: शोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dried, dried up, desiccated.  E. शुष् to dry, aff. क्त ।
शोस्: शोस् Ind. A particle of reproach or contempt.
शौक: शौक n. (-कं) 	 1. A flock of parrots. 	 2. Sorrowfulness.  E. शुक a parrot, अञ् aff.
शौक्त: शौक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ती-क्तं) Acid, acetic.  E. शुक्त vinegar, अण् aff.
शौक्तिक: शौक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 	 1. Acid, acetic. 	 2. Relating to a pearl, &c. E. शुक्त or शुक्ति, and ठक् aff.
शौक्तेय: शौक्तेय n. (-यं) A pearl.  E. शुक्ति a pearl-oyster, ढक् aff.; also from शुक्तिका with the same, शौक्तिकेय ।
शौक्लिकेय: शौक्लिकेय m. (-यः) A sort of poison.  E. शुक्लिक a country, ढक् aff.: according to some it is the venom of a snake of the Amphisbœna kind.
शौक्ल्य: शौक्ल्य n. (-क्ल्यं) Whiteness, clearness.  E. शुक्ल white, अण् aff.
शौच: शौच n. (-चं) 	 1. Purification by ablution, &c. from personal defilement. 2. Purification at given periods from defilement caused by the death of a relation, &c. 	 3. The state or property of freedom from defilement, purity, cleanness.  E. शुचि purity, अण् aff.

शौचाचार: शौचाचार m. (-रः) A rule of purification, the mode in which the person is to be cleansed by ablution, &c., after voiding any excrement or contracting any impurity.  E. शौच purification, and आचार rule, rite.
शौचेय: शौचेय m. (-यः) A washerman.  E. शुचि cleaning, ढक् aff.
शौचेप्सु: शौचेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Wishing or intending to be purified.  E. शीच, इप्सु desirous.
शौट्: शौट्(ऋ)शौटृ r. 1st cl. (शौटति) To be proud.
शौटीर: शौटीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A hero. 	 2. An ascetic, one who abandons the world. 	 3. A proud or haughty man, but of low tribe or occupation, an upstart.  E. शौट् to be proud, and इरन् Unādi aff.; also as derived from शौड the same, शौडीर; also the short vowel being substituted for the diphthong, शुटीर ।
शौटीर्य: शौटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Heroism, prowess. 	 2. Pride, arrogance.  E. शौटीर a hero, and ष्यञ् aff.
शौटीर्य्य: शौटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 	 1. Heroism, prowess. 	 2. Pride, arrogance.  E. शौटीर a hero, and ष्यञ् aff.
शौड्: शौड्(ऋ)शौडृ r. 1st cl. (शौडति) To be proud.
शौण्ड: शौण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं) 	 1. Drunk, intoxicated. 	 2. Fond of, addicted to, (as liquor.) 	 3. Skilful, (with a loc.) as in अक्षशौण्ड । f. (-ण्डी) 	 1. Long-pepper. 	 2. Another sort, (Piper chavya.)  E. शुण्डा spirituous liquor, अण् aff.
शौण्डिक: शौण्डिक m. (-कः) A distiller and vender of spirituous liquors. 	 f. (-की) A female keeper of a tavern or dram-shop.  E. शुण्डा spirits, ठञ् aff.
शौण्डिर: शौण्डिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 	 1. Proud, haughty. 	 2. Elevated, looking upwards; more properly शौडीर, and शौठीर as above.
शौद्धोदनि: शौद्धोदनि m. (-निः) BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect.  E. शुद्धो-दन a prince of the family of IKSHWĀKU, and इञ् aff. of descent.
शौद्र: शौद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Śūdra, servile, relating or belonging to the last class. 	 m. (-द्रः) The son of a man of either of the first three classes by a Śūdra woman, the last of the twelve sons acknowledged in the ancient Hindu law.  E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and अण् aff.
शौधिका: शौधिका f. (-का) A white variety of panic-seed.  E. शोधः शोधन मलविरेकस्तस्मै हितः ठक् ।

शौनक: शौनक m. (-कः) The name of an inspired legislator older than MANU.
शौनिक: शौनिक m. (-कः) 	 1. A butcher, a poulterer, a vender of the flesh of beasts or birds. 	 2. Chase, hunting.  E. शूना a slaughter-house, ठञ् or ठक् aff.
शौभ: शौभ n. (-भं) The city of HARISCHANDRA, suspended in the air. 	 m. (-भः) 1. A god, a divinity. 	 2. The betel-nut tree.  E. शुभ, अण् aff.
शौभनेय: शौभनेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 	 1. Sprung from a handsome mother. 	 2. Relating to anything handsome or brilliant.  E. शोभना a handsome woman, aff. ढक् ।
शौभाञ्जन: शौभाञ्जन m. (-नः) The Sajinā-tree.  E. अण् pleonasm, added to शोभाञ्जन q. v.
शौभिक: शौभिक m. (-कः) A juggler, a conjurer.  E. शौभं व्योमपुरं शिल्पमस्य ठक् ।

श्राद्ध: श्राद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Faithful, believing. 	 n. (-द्धं) A funeral ceremony observed at various fixed periods and for different purposes, con-sisting of offerings with water and fire to the gods and manes, and gifts and food to the relations present and assisting Brāh-mans; it is especially performed for a present recently deceased, or for three paternal ancestors or for all ancestors collectively, and is supposed necessary to secure the ascent and residence of the souls of the deceased in a world appropriated to the manes, The following distributions of this ceremony are specified: the पार्व्वणं in honour of three ancestors, एकोद्दिष्टं of one, नित्यं regular, नैमित्तिकं occasionally, काम्यं for the attainment of some particular object, आह्निकं daily, वृद्धिः for the obtaining of increase of pros-perity, and सपिण्डनं in which the balls of meat offered to the deceased individually and collectively are blended together. There are many other kinds: those for a person recently decea-sed are one on the day after mourning expires, and twelve others in twelve successive months; one at the end of the third fort-night, one in the sixth month, and one in the twelfth, concluding with a Sapiṇḍaṇa, on the anniversary of the person's death; in general they are all performed in the course of the two or three first days, and the Śrāddha for the deceased is only annually repeated. There is also a short of Śrāddha performed daily during the days of mourning, usually ten, on which a funeral cake is presented, increasing one or more each day till ten cakes are offered.  E. श्रद्धा faith, अण् or ण aff. of possession or relation, as the abandonment or presentation of meat, &c., through faith of its efficacy, in behalf of the souls of the deceased.

श्वासिन्: श्वासिन् m. (-सी) 	 1. Air, wind. 	 2. A living creature.  E. श्वास breath, and इनि aff.
श्वि: श्वि (इर टु and ओ) टुओश्वि r. 1st cl. (श्वयति) 	 1. To move, to go, or go to. 2. To grow, to increase. 	 3. To swell. With उद्, To swell.
श्वित्: श्वित्(आ)श्विता r. 1st cl. (श्वेतते) To be white.
श्विति: श्विति f. (-तिः) Whiteness.  E. श्वित् to be white, कि aff.
श्वित्र: श्वित्र n. (-त्रं) Whiteness of the skin, vitiligo.  E. श्वित् to be white, Unādi aff. रक् ।
श्वित्रघ्नी: श्वित्रघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A plant, (Tragia involucrata.)  E. श्वित्र vitiligo, घ्न destroy-ing.
श्वित्रिन्: श्वित्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) Affected with vitiligo or whiteness of the skin.  E. श्वित्र, इनि aff.
श्विद्: श्विद्(इ)श्विदि r. 1st cl. (श्विन्दति) To be white, to become or continue so.
श्वृ: श्वृ r. 9th cl. (श्वृणाति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
श्वेत: श्वेत mfn. (-तः-ता or नी-तं) White. 	 m. (-तः) 	 1. White, (the colour.) 	 2. The planet VENUS, or its regent ŚUKRA. 	 3. The sixth range of moun-tains, dividing the known continent, the white mountains separa-ting the Varshas of Hiranmaya and Romanaka. 	 4. One of the minor Dwipas or divisions of the world; in fable the White Island, identified geographically by WILFORD, with Britain. 	 5. A white cloud. 	 6. Cummin-seed. 	 7. A conch. 	 mf. (-तः-ता) A small white shell used as a coin, a Cowrie. 	 n. (-तं) Silver. 	 f. (-ता) 	 1. A grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) 	 2. A plant, Kāshṭha-Pātala. 3. A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.) 	 4. Hogweed. 	 5. Bent grass with white blossoms. 	 6. Bamboo-manna. 	 7. Crystal. 	 8. Clayed or can-died sugar. 	 9. A cowrie.  E. श्वित् to be white, aff. अच् or घञ् ।
श्वेतक: श्वेतक m. (-कः) A Cowri. 	 n. (-कं) Silver.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
श्वेतकुञ्जर: श्वेतकुञ्जर m. (-रः) INDRA'S elephant.  E. श्वेत white, and कुञ्जर an elephant.
श्वेतकेतु: श्वेतकेतु m. (-तुः) A Bauddha or Jaina saint.  E. श्वेत white, केतु a banner.
श्वेत्रकेश: श्वेत्रकेश m. (-शः) A variety of the Hyperanthera morunga.  E. श्वेत white, and केश a filament.
श्वेतकोल: श्वेतकोल m. (-लः) The Saphara fish, (Cyprinus Sophore, HAM.)
श्वेतखदिर: श्वेतखदिर m. (-रः) A white variety of the Mimosa catechu.  E. श्वेत, and खदिर the Khayer.
श्वेतगज: श्वेतगज m. (-जः) 	 1. A white elephant. 	 2. Airāvata, the elephant of INDRA.  E. श्वेत white, and गज an elephant.
श्वेतगरुत्: श्वेतगरुत् m. (-रुत्) A goose.  E. श्वेत white, and गरुत् a wing.
श्वेतच्छद: श्वेतच्छद m. (-दः) 	 1. A goose. 	 2. A kind of basil, (Ocymum album, &c.)  E. श्वेत white, and च्छद a feather or leaf.
श्वेतटङ्कण: श्वेतटङ्कण n. (-णं) White or refined borax.  E. श्वेत white, and टङ्कण the same.
श्वेतदूर्वा: श्वेतदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A bent grass with white blossoms.  E. श्वेत and दूर्व्वा Durbā grass.
श्वेतदूर्व्वा: श्वेतदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A bent grass with white blossoms.  E. श्वेत and दूर्व्वा Durbā grass.
श्वेतद्विप: श्वेतद्विप m. (-पः) 	 1. A White elephant. 	 2. INDRA'S elephant.  E. श्वेत white, and द्विप an elephant.
श्वेतद्वीप: श्वेतद्वीप m. (-पः) The white Island, or a minor division of the universe so called; also termed Chandra-Dwipa, and supposed by WIL-FORD to be Britain.  E. श्वेत white, and द्वीप an island; also श्वेत q. v.
श्वेतधातु: श्वेतधातु m. (-तुः) 	 1. Chalk. 	 2. The milk stone, opal or chalcedony. E. श्वेत white, धातु a mineral.
श्वेतधामन्: श्वेतधामन् m. (-मा) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor. 	 3. Cuttle-fish-bone. E. श्वेत white, धामन् a ray.
श्वेतनील: श्वेतनील m. (-लः) A cloud.  E. श्वेत white, and नील black or dark blue.
श्वेतपत्र: श्वेतपत्र m. (-त्रः) A goose.  E. श्वेत white, पत्र a feather.
श्वेतपत्ररथ: श्वेतपत्ररथ m. (-थः) BRAHMĀ.  E. श्वेतपत्र a goose, रथ a car or conveyance.
श्वेतपद्म: श्वेतपद्म n. (-द्मं) The white lotus.  E. श्वेत white, and पद्म a lotus.
श्वेतपर्णास: श्वेतपर्णास m. (-सः) Holy basil, or a variety of it, (Ocymum sanctum or album.)  E. श्वेत white, and पर्णास the same.
श्वेतपाटला: श्वेतपाटला f. (-ला) The white trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. श्वेत white, पाटला the same. “शादा पारुल ।”
श्वेतपिङ्ग: श्वेतपिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A lion.  E. श्वेत white, and पिङ्ग tawny; of a light tawny colour.
श्वेतपिङ्गल: श्वेतपिङ्गल m. (-लः) 	 1. A lion. 	 2. ŚIVA.  E. श्वेत white, and पिङ्गल tawny: see the last; also with कन् added, श्वेतपिङ्गलक ।
श्वेतपुष्प: श्वेतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Vitex trifolia.) 	 f. (-ष्पा) The Ghoshā-plant. E. श्वेत white, and पुष्प a flower.
श्वेतपुष्पक: श्वेतपुष्पक m. (-कः) A plant, (Nerium odorum, the white variety.) E. कन् added to the last.
श्वेतप्रसूनक: श्वेतप्रसूनक m. (-कः) A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) श्वेत white, (flowers,) प्रसूनक productive.
श्वेतमरिच: श्वेतमरिच n. (-चं) The seed of the Hyperanthera morunga.  E. श्वेत white, मरिच pepper.
श्वेतरक्त: श्वेतरक्त m. (-क्तः) Pale red or pink, (the colour.)  E. श्वेत white, रक्त red.
श्वेतरञ्जन: श्वेतरञ्जन n. (-नं) Lead.  E. श्वेत white, रञ्जन colouring.
श्वेतरथ: श्वेतरथ m. (-थः) The planet VENUS.  E. श्वेत white, and रथ a car.
श्वेतरास्रा: श्वेतरास्रा f. (-स्रा) A plant, white Rasan: see रास्रा.
श्वेतरोचिस्: श्वेतरोचिस् m. (-चिः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. Camphor.  E. श्वेत white, रोचिस् light.
श्वेतरोहित: श्वेतरोहित m. (-तः) GARUḌA.  E. श्वेत white, and रोहित red.
श्वेतवचा: श्वेतवचा f. (-चा) Orris root, (Acorus calamus.)  E. श्वेत white, and वचा the same.
श्वेतवल्कल: श्वेतवल्कल m. (-लः) Glomerous-fig-tree, (Ficus glomerata.)  E. श्वेत white, वल्कल bark.
श्वेतवाजिन्: श्वेतवाजिन् m. (-जी) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. The prince ARJUNA.  E. श्वेत white, वाजि a horse, इनि aff.
श्वेतवासस्: श्वेतवासस् m. (-साः) A religious mendicant, wearing white garments. E. श्वेत, and वासस् vesture.
श्वेतवाह: श्वेतवाह m. (-हः) 	 1. ARJUNA. 	 2. INDRA. 	 3. The moon.  E. श्वेत white, वाह a horse.
श्वेतवाहन: श्वेतवाहन m. (-नः) 	 1. The moon. 	 2. ARJUNA. 	 3. INDRA. 	 4. The Makara, a marine monster.  E. श्वेत white, वाहन a vehicle.
श्वेतवाहिन्: श्वेतवाहिन् m. (-ही) ARJUNA.  E. श्वेत white, वाह a vehicle, (a horse,) इनि aff.
श्वेतशुङ्ग: श्वेतशुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Barley.  E. श्वेत white, and शुङ्ग awn; also read श्वेतशृङ्ग ।
श्वेतसर्प: श्वेतसर्प m. (-र्पः) 	 1. A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) 	 2. A white snake.  E. श्वेत white, सर्प what creeps or grows, or a serpent.
श्वेतसार: श्वेतसार m. (-रः) A tree, (Mimosa catechu.)  E. श्वेत white, सार pith or essence.
श्वेतसुरसा: श्वेतसुरसा f. (-सा) A white variety of the Nyctanthes arbor tristis.  E. श्वेत white, and सुरसा the Rasan, &c., to which it is compared.
श्वेतहय: श्वेतहय m. (-यः) 	 1. A white horse. 	 2. The horse of INDRA. 	 3. A name of ARJUNA.  E. श्वेत white, and हय a horse.
श्वेतहस्तिन्: श्वेतहस्तिन् m. (-स्ती) 	 1. A white elephant. 	 2. The elephant of INDRA. E. श्वेत white, and हस्तिन् an elephant.
श्वेतार्क: श्वेतार्क m. (-र्कः) Gigantic swallow-wort, (Asclepias gigantea,) with white flowers.  E. श्वेत white, and अर्क the same.
श्वेतोदर: श्वेतोदर m. (-रः) KUVERA.  E. श्वेत white, and उदर the belly.
श्वेतौही: श्वेतौही f. (-ही) An epithet of ŚACHI, the wife of INDRA.
श्वेनी: श्वेनी f. (-नी) One of the fem. form of श्वेतः see श्वेत ।
श्वैत्य: श्वैत्य n. (-त्यं) 	 1. Whiteness. 	 2. Vitiligo.  E. श्वित or श्वेत, and ष्यञ् aff.
श्वैत्र: श्वैत्र n. (-त्रं) Vitiligo.  E. श्वेत to be white, रन् aff.; also श्वैत्र्य ।
श्वोवसीयस: श्वोवसीयस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Auspicious, fortunate. 	 n. (-सं) good fortune. E. श्वेस and वस both particles implying auspiciousness, ईयसुन् affixed to the latter, and a final vowel added to the compound.
